title: Predavanje na Elektrotehničkom fakultetu
excerpt: UZNR CG i NVO MADOP održali su 16. decembra 2022. u Podgorici deseto po redu predavanje o zaštiti i zdravlju na radu za studente Elektrotehničkog fakulteta.
content:
Podgorica, 16.12.2022.
Dana 16.12.2022. održano je deseto po redu predavanje iz oblasti zaštite i zdravlja na radu na Elektro fakultetu, u Podgorici, u saradnji NVO UZNR CG i NVO MADOP.
Cilj ovog predavanja, kao i svih prethodnih, koja se, u okviru projekta „Dostojanstven rad počinje dok si mlad“, organizuju u saradnji sa NVO Prima i uz finansijsku podršku Evropske komisije, je da se mladi ljudi upoznaju sa osnovnim načelima zaštite i zdravlja na radu, njihovim pravima i odgovornostima koje imaju kada zasnuju radni odnos, ali i obavezama i odgovornostima koje poslodavci imaju prema njima kao svojim zaposlenima.
Osim toga, cilj ovog predavanja je bilo upoznavanje studenata, budućih elektro inženjera, sa brojnim opasnim materijama, koje se mogu sresti u elektronskom otpadu, a poseban rizik predstavljaju po zdravlje ljudi i životnu sredinu, kao elektronski otpd. Sa ovom temom su ih upoznali predstavnici NVO MADOP.
Nažalost, usljed organizovanja obuke u terminu završnih kolokvijuma i ispita na fakultetu, zainteresovanost studenata za ovo predavanje nije bila na zadovoljavajućem nivou.
title_en: Lecture at the Faculty of Electrical Engineering
excerpt_en: On 16 December 2022 in Podgorica UZNR CG and the NGO MADOP delivered their tenth lecture on occupational safety and health, for students of the Faculty of Electrical Engineering.
content_en:
Podgorica, 16 December 2022
On 16 December 2022 the tenth lecture on occupational safety and health was delivered at the Faculty of Electrical Engineering in Podgorica, jointly by the NGOs UZNR CG and MADOP.
The aim of this lecture, as of all those before it — organised under the project “Decent work starts while you are young” in cooperation with the NGO Prima and with financial support from the European Commission — is to acquaint young people with the basic principles of occupational safety and health, with the rights and responsibilities they will have when they enter employment, and with the obligations and responsibilities employers have towards them as employees.
Beyond that, the lecture set out to acquaint the students, as future electrical engineers, with the many hazardous substances that can be found in electronic waste, which poses a particular risk to human health and to the environment. Representatives of the NGO MADOP covered this subject with them.
Unfortunately, because the session was held at the time of end-of-term tests and examinations at the faculty, student interest in the lecture was not at a satisfactory level.

title: Obuka za zaposlene u Ministarstvu ekologije, prostornog planiranja i urbanizma
excerpt: Nakon radionice u kojoj su prepoznati problemi u opremljenosti građevinskih inspektora, UZNR CG je 16. novembra 2022. održalo obuku o zaštiti i zdravlju na radu za zaposlene u Ministarstvu ekologije, prostornog planiranja i urbanizma.
content:
Na radionici koja je održana u periodu od 26. do 28. oktobra, a na kojoj su učesnici bili predstavnici različitih ministarstava, prepoznati su brojni izazovi sa kojima se zaposleni u javnom sektoru svakodnevno susreću, kada je u pitanju oblast ZZNR, ali i nizak nivo znanja o ovoj veoma važnoj temi.
Jedan od prepoznatih problema je bio taj da građevinski inspektori (njih 35), koji poslove obavljaju u okviru Minstarstva ekologije, prostornog planiranja i urbanizma, prilikom inspekcijskih nadzora na gradilištima nemaju zaštitnu opremu.
Zaposleni koji su bili učesnici ove radionice su sa ovim problemom upoznali svoje nadležne, te je, shodno tome, donijeta odluka da Direktorat za inspekcijske poslove i licenciranje, odvoji sredstva za kupovinu zaštitne opreme za sve građevinske inspektore.
Nakon toga su organizovali obuku iz oblasti ZZNR za zaposlene u Ministarstvu ekologije, prostornog planiranja i urbanizma, 16.11.2022. godine, a predavači su bili: generalna sekretarka i projektna koordinatorka Udruženja zaštite na radu Crne Gore - Đina Janković i potpresjednik Udruženja zaštite na radu Crne Gore i inspektor zaštite i zdravlja na radu – Zlatko Popović.
Cilj ove obuke je bilo upoznavanje zaposlenih sa osnovnim načelima ZZNR, njihovim pravima i odgovornostima koje imaju, ali i obavezama i odgovornostima koje poslodavac ima prema njima kao svojim zaposlenima.
Istraživanje koje je Udruženje zaštite na radu Crne Gore sprovelo u prethodnom periodu, pokazuju da su zaposleni u javnom sektoru, kojih je preko 50.000, često nedovoljno informisani o važnosti ove teme, pa shodno tome nisu ni adekvatno zaštićeni na radnim mjestima, a kao rezultat imamo česte lakše i teške povrede.
Budući da poremećaji mišićno-koštanog sistema (MKS) spadaju u najčešća profesionalna oboljenja savremenog svijeta, a uzimajući u obzir činjenicu da najveći broj zaposlenih u ministarstvu obavlja upravo administrativne poslove, akcenat obuke bio je na podizanju svijesti o važnosti prevencije poremećaja MKS povezanih sa radom koji podrazumijeva dugotrajno statično držanje tijela u sjedećem položaju.
Uzimajući u obzir činjenicu da je ovo ministarstvo nadležno za uređenje prostora i izgradnju objekata, na obuci su bili prisutni i zaposleni u Direktoratu za građevinarstvo i Direktoratu za inspekcijske poslove i licenciranje – u okviru kojeg su radno angažovani urbanističko-građevinski inspektori.
S obzirom na to da je građevinski sektor najrazvijenija industrijska grana u Crnoj Gori, ali istovremeno i najrizičnija s aspekta bezbjednosti, na šta podsjećaju podaci o broju povreda na radu sa smrtnim ishodom, drugi dio obuke je bio posvećen osnovnim rizicima prilikom izvođenja radova na gradilištima, kao i o mjerama zaštite i zdravlja na radu. U prethodno pomenuto se ubrajaju: opšte, organizacione i tehničke mjere zaštite, periodični pregledi i ispitivanja, znakovi ZZNR i uputstva za bezbjedan rad, kao i periodična osposobljavanja za bezbjedan rad i provjera zdravstvenih sposobnosti.
Zaključak: Dobro upravljanje rizicima na radnom mjestu od koristi je za sve zaposlene, ali i poslodavce, bez obzira na to da li je u pitanju javni ili privatni sektor.
Na ovo upućuje i činjenica da se ogromni troškovi koji nastaju (4-6% BDP) isplaćuju iz budžeta za saniranje posljedica nastalih od neprimjenjivanja mjera ZZNR.
title_en: Training for staff of the Ministry of Ecology, Spatial Planning and Urbanism
excerpt_en: After a workshop identified problems with the equipment available to construction inspectors, on 16 November 2022 UZNR CG delivered occupational safety and health training for staff of the Ministry of Ecology, Spatial Planning and Urbanism.
content_en:
A workshop held from 26 to 28 October, attended by representatives of various ministries, identified numerous challenges that public sector employees face every day in occupational safety and health, and also a low level of knowledge about this very important subject.
One problem identified was that construction inspectors (35 of them), who work within the Ministry of Ecology, Spatial Planning and Urbanism, have no protective equipment when carrying out inspections on construction sites.
The employees who took part in the workshop raised this problem with their superiors, and a decision was accordingly taken for the Directorate for Inspection Affairs and Licensing to set aside funds to buy protective equipment for all construction inspectors.
They then organised occupational safety and health training for staff of the Ministry of Ecology, Spatial Planning and Urbanism, on 16 November 2022, delivered by the secretary general and project coordinator of the Occupational Safety Association of Montenegro, Đina Janković, and the vice-president of the Occupational Safety Association of Montenegro and occupational safety and health inspector, Zlatko Popović.
The aim of the training was to acquaint staff with the basic principles of occupational safety and health, with their own rights and responsibilities, and with the obligations and responsibilities the employer has towards them as employees.
Research carried out by the Occupational Safety Association of Montenegro shows that public sector employees, of whom there are more than 50,000, are often insufficiently informed about the importance of this subject and are consequently not adequately protected at work, with frequent minor and serious injuries as the result.
Since musculoskeletal disorders (MSDs) are among the most common occupational diseases of the modern world, and given that most of the ministry's staff do administrative work, the training focused on raising awareness of the importance of preventing work-related MSDs caused by prolonged static posture in a seated position.
Given that this ministry is responsible for spatial planning and construction, the training was also attended by staff of the Directorate for Construction and the Directorate for Inspection Affairs and Licensing, which employs urban planning and construction inspectors.
Since construction is the most developed industrial sector in Montenegro but at the same time the riskiest from a safety point of view — as the figures on fatal injuries at work remind us — the second part of the training was devoted to the basic risks of work on construction sites and to occupational safety and health measures. These include general, organisational and technical protective measures, periodic examinations and testing, OSH signage and safe working instructions, and periodic training for safe work and checks of fitness for work.
Conclusion: good risk management at the workplace benefits every employee, and employers too, whether in the public or the private sector.
That is underlined by the fact that the enormous costs incurred (4–6% of GDP) are paid from the budget to deal with the consequences of failing to apply occupational safety and health measures.

title: Predavanje na Mašinskom fakultetu
excerpt: UZNR CG je 9. novembra 2022, u saradnji sa NVO MADOP, održalo deveto po redu predavanje o zaštiti i zdravlju na radu za studente Mašinskog fakulteta u Podgorici.
content:
Udruženje zaštite na radu Crne Gore je 09.11.2022. godine, u saradnji sa NVO MADOP, uspješno realizovalo deveto po redu predavanje iz oblasti zaštite i zdravlja na radu, za studente Mašinskog fakulteta.
Cilj ovih predavanja je da se studenti upoznaju sa osnovnim načelima zaštite i zdravlja na radu.
I ovo predavanje je pokazalo veoma nizak nivo znanja studenata o zaštiti i zdravlju na radu u njihovom budućem radu, kao i neophodnost uvođenja ovog predmeta.
Osim toga, poseban akcenat je stavljen i na zaštiti zdravlja i životne sredine od uticaja opasnih materija. Kako da prepoznaju rizike opasnih materija, kako da se na adekvatan način zaštite, ali i kako da ih pravilno odlažu, studentima prezentovali predavači iz NVO MADOP.
title_en: Lecture at the Faculty of Mechanical Engineering
excerpt_en: On 9 November 2022, together with the NGO MADOP, UZNR CG delivered its ninth lecture on occupational safety and health, for students of the Faculty of Mechanical Engineering in Podgorica.
content_en:
On 9 November 2022 the Occupational Safety Association of Montenegro, together with the NGO MADOP, successfully delivered its ninth lecture on occupational safety and health, for students of the Faculty of Mechanical Engineering.
The aim of these lectures is to acquaint students with the basic principles of occupational safety and health.
This lecture too showed a very low level of knowledge among students about occupational safety and health in their future work, and the need to introduce the subject.
Particular emphasis was also placed on protecting health and the environment from the effects of hazardous substances. Lecturers from the NGO MADOP showed students how to recognise the risks of hazardous substances, how to protect themselves properly and how to dispose of such substances correctly.

title: Predavanje na Metalurško-tehnološkom fakultetu
excerpt: UZNR CG i NVO MADOP realizovali su 7. novembra 2022. osmo po redu predavanje o zaštiti i zdravlju na radu za studente Metalurško-tehnološkog fakulteta.
content:
Udruženje zaštite na radu Crne Gore je, u saradnji sa NVO MADOP, 07.11.2022. godine uspješno realizovalo osmo po redu predavanje iz oblasti zaštite i zdravlja na radu, za studente Metalurško-tehnološkog fakuleta, a predavanju su prisustvovali i profesori.
Cilj ovih predavanja je da se studenti upoznaju sa osnovnim načelima zaštite i zdravlja na radu, ali i uticajem opasnih materija, koje su prisutne u metalutško-tehnološkim procesima rada, na zdravlje zaposlenih i životnu sredinu, o čemu su sa studentima razgovarali predstavnici NVO UZNR CG i NVO Mreže za afirmaciju društveno odgovornog poslovanja.
U ranijem periodu je bilo riječi o otvaranju novog studijskog programa, upravo na ovom fakultetu, koji bi obuhvatio oblast zaštite i zdravlja na radu, ali zbog nedostatka kapaciteta, kadrova i novčanih sredstava, ovaj plan nikada nije realizovan, ali to ne znači da se ova tema neće ponovo aktuelizovati ukoliko se stvore adekvatni uslovi za to.
Za sada ostaje mogućnost uvođenja predmeta zaštite i zdravlja na radu kroz koji bi se budući inženjeri metalurgije, hemijske tehnologije i zaštite životne sredine upoznali sa ovom veoma značajnom temom. Na taj način bi studenti na vrijeme, prije stupanja na tržište rada, usvojili osnovna znanja o zaštiti i zdravlju na radu u cilju preventivnog djelovanja, a što bi im omogućilo da usvoje pozitivan odnos o ovoj temi, stekli bi znanja, razvili vještine i sposobnosti da identifikuju opasnosti i rizike na radnom mjestu i nađu rešenja za njihovu potpunu eliminaciju ili umanjivanje do prihvatljivog nivoa, a sve u skladu s ubrzanim razvojem tehnologija.
Znanja stečena na ovaj način, tokom obrazovanja i razvoja ličnosti, su najbolja osnova za njihovo dalje proširivanje i usavršavanje kod budućih učesnika u radnim procesima. Posjedovanje znanja iz oblasti zaštite na radu sa stanovišta bezbjednosti važno je za studente i prilikom izvođenja praktične nastave u laboratorijama i kod poslodavca.
title_en: Lecture at the Faculty of Metallurgy and Technology
excerpt_en: On 7 November 2022 UZNR CG and the NGO MADOP delivered their eighth lecture on occupational safety and health, for students of the Faculty of Metallurgy and Technology.
content_en:
On 7 November 2022 the Occupational Safety Association of Montenegro, together with the NGO MADOP, successfully delivered its eighth lecture on occupational safety and health, for students of the Faculty of Metallurgy and Technology; professors also attended.
The aim of these lectures is to acquaint students with the basic principles of occupational safety and health, and also with the effects on employees' health and on the environment of the hazardous substances present in metallurgical and technological processes, which representatives of the NGO UZNR CG and the NGO Network for the Affirmation of Socially Responsible Business discussed with the students.
There was talk in the past of opening a new study programme at this very faculty that would cover occupational safety and health, but for lack of capacity, staff and funds the plan was never carried out — which does not mean the subject will not be raised again if the right conditions arise.
For now the option remains of introducing an occupational safety and health course through which future engineers in metallurgy, chemical technology and environmental protection would learn about this very important subject. In that way students would acquire, in good time and before entering the labour market, the basic knowledge of occupational safety and health needed for preventive action, which would allow them to develop a positive attitude to the subject, gain knowledge and develop the skills and ability to identify hazards and risks at the workplace and find ways to eliminate them entirely or reduce them to an acceptable level, all in step with the rapid development of technology.
Knowledge gained in this way, during education and personal development, is the best basis for future participants in the world of work to build on and refine. Knowledge of occupational safety from a safety point of view also matters for students during practical instruction in laboratories and with employers.

title: Predavanje u JU Srednja građevinsko-geodetska škola „Inž. Marko Radević“ (novembar 2022)
excerpt: UZNR CG je 3. novembra 2022, u saradnji sa NVO MADOP, održalo sedmo po redu predavanje o zaštiti i zdravlju na radu za učenike Srednje građevinsko-geodetske škole „Inž. Marko Radević“.
content:
Udruženje zaštite na radu Crne Gore je, u saradnji sa NVO MADOP, 03.11.2022. godine uspješno realizovalo sedmo po redu predavanje iz oblasti zaštite i zdravlja na radu za učenike JU Srednja građevinsko-geodetska škola „Inž. Marko Radević“.
Predavanju su prisustvovale predstavnice Ministarstva prosvjete, Direktorata za opšte srednje obrazovanje, stručno obrazovanje i cjeloživotno učenje - Tamara Martinović i Marija Milić.
Cilj ovih predavanja, koja se realizuju u okviru projekta „Dostojanstven rad počinje dok si mlad“, finansiran od strane Evropske komisije, je da se učenici upoznaju sa osnovnim načelima zaštite i zdravlja na radu, njihovim pravima i odgovornostima koje imaju kada zasnuju radni odnos, ali i obavezama i odgovornostima koje poslodavci imaju prema njima kao svojim zaposlenima.
Poseban akcenat je stavljen na opasne materije u građevinskom sektoru, s kojima se zaposleni u ovoj grani industije svakodnevno susreću, o čemu su govorili predstavnici NVO MADOP, s aspekta profesionalnih oboljenja i zagađenja životne sredine.
Shodno odgovorima koje su đaci dali, popunjavajući upitnik prije predavanja, može se zaključiti da ne posjeduju gotovo nikakva znanja iz oblasti zaštite i zdravlja na radu, što je posljedica neizučavanja ove teme u okviru obrazovnog procesa. Ovo je jedan od razloga zašto ova škola nije ušla u sistem dualnog obrazovanja, jer je bez adekvatnih znanja i primjene mjera iz oblasti zaštite i zdravlja na radu - nemoguće realizovati praktičnu nastavu na radnim mjestima na kojima postoji izražen rizik od povređivanja.
Napomena: Građevinski sektor je najrazvijenija industrijska grana u Crnoj Gori koja zapošljava između 17 i 20 hiljada ljudi, ali istovremeno i najrizičnija sa aspekta bezbjednosti, na šta podsjeća podatak da je u prošloj godini na crnogorskim gradilištima život izgubilo 7 ljudi, a isti broj smrtno stradalih je zabilježen i za prvih 10 mjeseci ove godine.
Ovo potvrđuje neophodnost uvođenja zaštite i zdravlja na radu u obrazovni sistem Crne Gore kako bismo spriječili da mladi ljudi, budući nosioci razvoja našeg društva, zbog neinformisanosti budu neadekvatno zaštićeni na radnom mjestu.
Ukoliko se mladima obezbijede informacije koje su im potrebne oni će biti bolje pripremljeni za svoje prvo radno iskustvo i razumjeće svoja prava i dužnosti u odnosu na pravednu radnu praksu i radna prava.
title_en: Lecture at the “Inž. Marko Radević” Secondary School of Construction and Geodesy (November 2022)
excerpt_en: On 3 November 2022, together with the NGO MADOP, UZNR CG delivered its seventh lecture on occupational safety and health, for pupils of the “Inž. Marko Radević” Secondary School of Construction and Geodesy.
content_en:
On 3 November 2022 the Occupational Safety Association of Montenegro, together with the NGO MADOP, successfully delivered its seventh lecture on occupational safety and health for pupils of the “Inž. Marko Radević” Secondary School of Construction and Geodesy.
The lecture was attended by representatives of the Ministry of Education, Directorate for General Secondary Education, Vocational Education and Lifelong Learning — Tamara Martinović and Marija Milić.
The aim of these lectures, delivered under the project “Decent work starts while you are young”, financed by the European Commission, is to acquaint pupils with the basic principles of occupational safety and health, with the rights and responsibilities they will have when they enter employment, and with the obligations and responsibilities employers have towards them as employees.
Particular emphasis was placed on the hazardous substances in the construction sector that workers in the industry meet every day, which representatives of the NGO MADOP discussed from the point of view of occupational disease and environmental pollution.
Judging by the answers the pupils gave in the questionnaire completed before the lecture, it can be concluded that they have almost no knowledge of occupational safety and health, the result of the subject not being taught within the educational process. This is one of the reasons the school has not entered the dual education system, since without adequate knowledge and the application of occupational safety and health measures it is impossible to deliver practical instruction at workplaces where there is a pronounced risk of injury.
Note: construction is the most developed industrial sector in Montenegro, employing between 17,000 and 20,000 people, but at the same time the riskiest from a safety point of view — a reminder of which is the fact that last year 7 people lost their lives on Montenegrin construction sites, with the same number of fatalities recorded in the first 10 months of this year.
This confirms the need to introduce occupational safety and health into Montenegro's education system, so that young people, the future bearers of our society's development, are not inadequately protected at work through lack of information.
If young people are given the information they need, they will be better prepared for their first experience of work and will understand their rights and duties in relation to fair working practice and labour rights.

title: Predavanje u JU Škola za srednje i više stručno obrazovanje „Sergije Stanić“
excerpt: Povodom Evropske nedjelje zaštite i zdravlja na radu, UZNR CG i NVO MADOP održali su 25. oktobra 2022. šesto po redu predavanje za učenike smjerova kuvar i restorater u školi „Sergije Stanić“.
content:
Udruženje zaštite na radu Crne Gore je, u saradnji sa NVO MADOP, u cilju obilježavanja Evropske nedjelje zaštite i zdravlja na radu, 25.10.2022. godine uspješno realizovalo šesto po redu predavanje iz oblasti zaštite i zdravlja na radu za učenike JU Škola za srednje i više stručno obrazovanje „Sergije Stanić“ - smjerova kuvar i restorater.
Takođe, jedan dio predavanja je bio posvećen upoznavanju učenika sa opasnim materijama, načinima i mjerama zaštite u cilju očuvanja zdravlja, ali i načinoma odlaganja, u cilju očuvanja životne sredine. Sa oviom temom su ih bliže upoznali eksperti iz NVO MADOP.
Cilj ovih predavanja, koja se realizuju u okviru projekta „Dostojanstven rad počinje dok si mlad“, je da se mladi ljudi upoznaju sa osnovnim načelima zaštite i zdravlja na radu, njihovim pravima i odgovornostima koje imaju kada zasnuju radni odnos, ali i obavezama i odgovornostima koje poslodavci imaju prema njima kao svojim zaposlenima.
Budući da u Crnoj Gori zaštita i zdravlje na radu nisu implementirani u obrazovni sistem, prije predavanja je sprovedeno anketiranje učenika, kako bi se stekao uvid u nivo njihovog znanja kada je ova oblast u pitanju, uzimajući u obzir to da se obrazuju za zanimanja koja nose brojne rizike s aspekta bezbjednosti. Rezultati anketiranja pokazuju da je neophodno mnogo više raditi na edukaciji, s obzirom na to da su mladi ljudi posebno podložni povredama na radu i da je kod njih rizik od povređivanja 40% veći nego kod starijih zaposlenih.
Do povređivanja najčešće dolazi zato što rade suviše naporno i/ili suviše brzo kako bi ostavili dobar utisak. Često nisu svjesni opasnosti od opreme na kojoj rade i ne poznaju dovoljno radno mjesto. Želja da pokažu da su u stanju da obavljaju posao može povećati vjerovatnoću da će doći do povrede. Uz to, mladi koji nisu potpuno upoznati sa svojim pravima ili nemaju dovoljno samopouzdanja na poslu, prihvataju radne zadatke čak i onda kada nisu sigurni da su u stanju da ih obave.
S obzirom na to da učenici ove srednje škole pohađaju praksu koja se organizuje u školskim radionicama ili kod poslodavca, na određenim smjerovima već od I razreda - neophodno je što hitnije uvesti zaštitu i zdravlje na radu u obrazovne programe, kako bi bili pripremljeni da radne zadatke od samog starta obavljaju na bezbjedan način.
Nastavnike ove škole je takođe nephodno osposobiti za bezbjedan rad, što će biti jedna od narednih aktivnosti koje će Udruženje zaštite na radu Crne Gore realizovati u ovoj obrazovnoj instituciji.
title_en: Lecture at the “Sergije Stanić” School of Secondary and Higher Vocational Education
excerpt_en: To mark European Week for Safety and Health at Work, on 25 October 2022 UZNR CG and the NGO MADOP delivered their sixth lecture, for pupils on the cook and restaurateur streams at the “Sergije Stanić” school.
content_en:
To mark European Week for Safety and Health at Work, on 25 October 2022 the Occupational Safety Association of Montenegro, together with the NGO MADOP, successfully delivered its sixth lecture on occupational safety and health for pupils of the “Sergije Stanić” School of Secondary and Higher Vocational Education, on the cook and restaurateur streams.
Part of the lecture was also devoted to acquainting pupils with hazardous substances and with the ways and means of protection needed to preserve health, and with methods of disposal that protect the environment. Experts from the NGO MADOP covered this subject with them in more detail.
The aim of these lectures, delivered under the project “Decent work starts while you are young”, is to acquaint young people with the basic principles of occupational safety and health, with the rights and responsibilities they will have when they enter employment, and with the obligations and responsibilities employers have towards them as employees.
Since occupational safety and health is not part of the education system in Montenegro, pupils were surveyed before the lecture in order to gain an insight into their level of knowledge in this field, given that they are training for occupations that carry numerous safety risks. The survey results show that far more work must be done on education, since young people are particularly prone to injuries at work and their risk of injury is 40% higher than that of older employees.
Injuries most often occur because they work too hard and/or too fast in order to make a good impression. They are often unaware of the dangers of the equipment they work with and do not know the workplace well enough. The wish to show that they are capable of doing the job can increase the likelihood of an injury. In addition, young people who are not fully aware of their rights or who lack confidence at work accept tasks even when they are not sure they can carry them out.
Since pupils at this secondary school do work placements organised in the school workshops or with employers — on some streams already from the first year — occupational safety and health must be introduced into the curricula as a matter of urgency, so that they are prepared to carry out their tasks safely from the very start.
The school's teachers also need to be trained in safe work, which will be one of the next activities the Occupational Safety Association of Montenegro carries out at this institution.

title: Predavanje u JU Srednja stručna škola „Ivan Uskoković“ (oktobar 2022)
excerpt: U saradnji sa NVO MADOP, UZNR CG je održalo predavanje o zaštiti i zdravlju na radu za učenike Srednje stručne škole „Ivan Uskoković“.
content:
Još jedna uspješno realizovana obuka iz oblasti zaštite i zdravlja na radu, za učenike JU Srednje stručne škole „Ivan Uskoković“, u saradnji sa NVO MADOP.
Osnovni cilj ovih obuka je omogućavanje mladim ljudima da dobiju osnovne informacije koje su im neophodne kako bi se bolje pripremili za tržište rada i razumjeli svoja prava i dužnosti u odnosu na pravednu radnu praksu i radno pravo.
Po poslednjem popisu Crna Gora ima 620.029 stanovnika, od čega su 132.702 mladi ljudi uzrasta od 15 do 29 godina. Prema podacima Evropske agencije za zastitu i zdravlje na radu (EU OSHA), vjerovatnoća da će mladi ljudi starosti 16 do 29 godina doživjeti povredu na radu je do 40% veća nego kod starijih zaposlenih.
Budući da su povrede na radnom mjestu i profesionalne bolesti odgovorne za smrt oko 2 miliona zaposlenih širom svijeta, na godišnjem nivou, neophodno je mladim ljudima kroz proces obrazovanja pružiti osnovne informacije i mogućnosti da steknu neophodna znanja o zaštiti i zdravlju na radu, kao i o njihovim pravima i odgovornostima koje imaju kada zasnuju radni odnos.
Takođe, cilj ovih predavanja je i upoznavanje učenika sa opasnim materijama, njihovim uticajem na zdravlje ljudi, rizicima koji dovode do profesionalnih oboljenja i mogićnostima zagađenja životne sredine, ukoliko se te opasne materije ne odlažu na adekvatan način. S ovom temom su ih upoznali eksperti za zaštitu životne sredine iz NVO MADOP.
Kada su srednje stručne škole u pitanju - škola i poslodavac su dužni da obuče učenike osnovnim mjerama i sredstvima zaštite na radu pri izvođenju praktičnog obrazovanja, jer je jedan od ciljeva dualnog obrazovanja razvijanje svijesti o važnosti rada na bezbjedan način.
Shodno zakonu - zaštitu na radu obezbjeđuju škola i poslodavac, međutim, u praksi to izostaje jer nastavnici nemaju znanja iz ove oblasti koja bi mogli da prenesu učenicima.
Da bismo smanjili broj povreda na radu, profesionalnih oboljenja i smrtnih slučajeva na radu, moramo djelovati na uzroke, jer bavljenje posljedicama nikada neće doprinijeti promjenama. Jedini način koji će dovesti do ostvarenja cilja su osvješćene, odgovorne i zdrave buduće generacije, što je jedino moguće postići implementacijom zaštite i zdravlja na radu u obrazovni sistem Crne Gore.
title_en: Lecture at the “Ivan Uskoković” Secondary Vocational School (October 2022)
excerpt_en: Together with the NGO MADOP, UZNR CG delivered a lecture on occupational safety and health for pupils of the “Ivan Uskoković” Secondary Vocational School.
content_en:
Another successfully delivered training session on occupational safety and health, for pupils of the “Ivan Uskoković” Secondary Vocational School, in cooperation with the NGO MADOP.
The basic aim of these sessions is to give young people the basic information they need in order to be better prepared for the labour market and to understand their rights and duties in relation to fair working practice and labour law.
According to the last census Montenegro has 620,029 inhabitants, of whom 132,702 are young people aged 15 to 29. According to the European Agency for Safety and Health at Work (EU-OSHA), young people aged 16 to 29 are up to 40% more likely to suffer an injury at work than older employees.
Since injuries at the workplace and occupational diseases are responsible for the deaths of some 2 million employees worldwide each year, young people must be given, through the educational process, the basic information and the opportunity to acquire the necessary knowledge about occupational safety and health and about the rights and responsibilities they will have when they enter employment.
These lectures also set out to acquaint pupils with hazardous substances, their effects on human health, the risks that lead to occupational diseases and the potential for environmental pollution if such substances are not disposed of properly. Environmental protection experts from the NGO MADOP covered this subject with them.
In the case of secondary vocational schools, the school and the employer are required to train pupils in the basic occupational safety measures and equipment during practical education, since one of the aims of dual education is to develop an awareness of the importance of working safely.
Under the law, protection at work is provided by the school and the employer; in practice, however, this does not happen, because teachers lack the knowledge in this field that they would need to pass on to pupils.
If we are to reduce the number of injuries at work, occupational diseases and deaths at work, we must act on the causes, because dealing with consequences will never bring change. The only way to achieve that goal is through aware, responsible and healthy future generations, which is possible only by introducing occupational safety and health into Montenegro's education system.

title: Predavanje u JU „Srednja elektro-ekonomska škola“ – Bijelo Polje (2022)
excerpt: UZNR CG i NVO MADOP održali su 18. oktobra 2022. radionicu o zaštiti i zdravlju na radu za učenike pravnog, ekonomskog i elektro smjera Srednje elektro-ekonomske škole u Bijelom Polju.
content:
Udruženje zaštite na radu Crne Gore je, zajedno sa NVO MADOP; 18.10.2022. godine uspješno realizovalo još jednu radionicu iz oblasti zaštite i zdravlja na radu za učenike pravnog, ekonomskog i elektro smjera, u Srednjoj elekto-ekonomskoj školi u Bijelom Polju.
Učenici su bili veoma aktivni i, svjesni svojih ograničenih znanja iz ove oblasti koja ne stiču kroz proces obrazovanja, postavljali su brojna pitanja. Dijelili su iskustva koja su mnogi od njih imali tokom ljeta kada su, obavljajući sezonske poslove, uglavnom bili angažovani „na crno“. Niko od njih tom prilikom nije prošao obavezno osposobljavanje za bezbjedan rad, a mnogi su u procecu obavljanja radnih zadataka bili izloženi brojnim opasnostima i rizicima.
Direktor škole Velibor Karličić, elektro inženjer po struci, svjestan rizika koje svako radno mjesto nosi a posebno ona za koja se obrazuju učenici elektro smjera - izrazio je žaljenje što se zaštita i zdravlje na radu ne izučava u srednjim školama i naglasio potrebu i neophodnost njene implementacije u obrazovni sistem.
Predavači iz NVO MADOP su sa učenicima razgovarali o opasnim materijama sa kojima će biti u kontaktu na budućim radnim mjestima. Nastojali su da im probliže rizike do kojih rad sa opasnim materijam amože dovesti, ukoliko se ti rizici ne prepoznaju na vrijeme i ukoliko se ne preduzmu adekvatne mjere zaštite.
Budući da postoje veoma ograničene mogućnosti organizovanja prakse, koja je obavezna u okviru duolnog obrazovanja, bilo bi poželjno da učenici tokom nastave mogu da vide i upoznaju se sa različitim sredstvima i opremom lične zaštite i isntrumentima za ispitivanje električnih instalacija, kojom škola, nažalost, ne raspolaže.
Djeca i omladina su budućnost svakog društva, tako da osnovna znanja o zaštiti i zdravlju na radu treba da budu integrisana u vaspitno-obrazovni sistem Crne Gore, kako bi osigurali radnu snagu i stanovništvo koje je svjesno značaja zaštite i zdravlja na radu.
title_en: Lecture at the Secondary School of Electrical Engineering and Economics – Bijelo Polje (2022)
excerpt_en: On 18 October 2022 UZNR CG and the NGO MADOP held a workshop on occupational safety and health for pupils on the law, economics and electrical engineering streams at the Secondary School of Electrical Engineering and Economics in Bijelo Polje.
content_en:
On 18 October 2022 the Occupational Safety Association of Montenegro, together with the NGO MADOP, successfully delivered another workshop on occupational safety and health for pupils on the law, economics and electrical engineering streams at the Secondary School of Electrical Engineering and Economics in Bijelo Polje.
The pupils were very active and, aware of their limited knowledge in a field they are not taught in school, asked a great many questions. They shared the experiences many of them had over the summer when, doing seasonal work, they were mostly engaged undeclared. None of them underwent the compulsory training for safe work, and many were exposed to numerous dangers and risks in the course of their work.
The school's head teacher, Velibor Karličić, an electrical engineer by profession, aware of the risks every workplace carries and particularly those the pupils on the electrical engineering stream are training for, expressed regret that occupational safety and health is not taught in secondary schools and emphasised the need for it to be built into the education system.
Lecturers from the NGO MADOP discussed with the pupils the hazardous substances they will come into contact with in their future workplaces. They sought to convey the risks that working with hazardous substances can carry if those risks are not recognised in time and adequate protective measures are not taken.
Since there are very limited opportunities to organise the work placements that are compulsory under dual education, it would be desirable for pupils to be able to see and learn about various types of personal protective equipment and instruments for testing electrical installations during lessons — equipment the school unfortunately does not have.
Children and young people are the future of any society, so basic knowledge of occupational safety and health should be integrated into Montenegro's education system, in order to secure a workforce and a population that is aware of the importance of safety and health at work.

title: Obuka „Mediji i zapošljavanje mladih“ u Petrovcu
excerpt: Koordinatorka projekta Đina Janković učestvovala je u periodu od 14. do 16. oktobra 2022. u Petrovcu na obuci „Mediji i zapošljavanje mladih“, u organizaciji NVO Prima.
content:
Saradnja medija i NVO sektora ključna u promovisanju zaštite i zdravlja na radu mladih
U periodu od 14. do 16. oktobra, u Petrovcu je održana obuka „Mediji i zapošljavanje mladih“ u organizaciji NVO Prima, a ispred Udruženja zaštite na radu Crne Gore učešće je uzela koordinatorka projekta Đina Janković.
Obuka je organizovana u okviru projekta „Western Balkan and Turkey for EmploYouth“ i mreže Omladinski HUB za Zapadni Balkan i Tursku.
Cilj obuke bio je stavljanje akcenta na važnost komunikacije i povećanja vidljivosti projekata finansiranih od strane Evropske unije, kako bi se na što bolji i efektivniji način ispunili željeni ciljevi i projektni rezultati – u ovom slučaju motivisali mladi ljude da ispune anketu koju sprovodi UZNR CG, s ciljem prikupljanja podataka o informisanosti mladih kada je u pitanju oblast zaštite i zdravlja na radu, broju povreda koje su imali na svojim radnim mjestima, kao i o profesionalnim oboljenjima, ali o tome da li su ostvarili svoja prava.
Na osnovu ovih podataka će moći da se ima realnija slika o stanju u ovoj oblasti, ali i o broju mladih koji su radno angažovani u zoni „sive ekonomije“.
Kao jedan od glavnih,,alata“ u postizanju tog cilja prepoznati su mediji i njihova uloga koju imaju u društvu u kreiranju preventivne kulture i informisanju građana, ali i njihov uticaj na donosioce odluka.
Istovremeno, na obuci je predstavljen i Indeks učešća mladih 2020 za Zapadni Balkan i Tursku, sa posebnim osvrtom na Crnu Goru.
Udruženje zaštite na radu Crne Gore će realizacijom aktivnosti u okviru projekta,,Dostojanstven rad počinje dok si mlad“, kroz edukativni priručnik koji je izradilo, kao i kroz predavanja u srednjim stručnim školama i na fakultetima - doprinijeti podizanju svijesti mladih i pružiti. Na ovaj način će se mladim ljudima pružiti informacije koje su im potrebne radi bolje pripremljenosti za prvo radno iskustvo, a takođe i za razumijevanje prava i dužnosti koje imaju u odnosu na pravednu radnu praksu i radna prava.
Takođe, UZNR CG će kvalitetno informisati javnost i donosioce odluka u cilju zagovaranja.

title_en: Training “Media and youth employment” in Petrovac
excerpt_en: From 14 to 16 October 2022 project coordinator Đina Janković took part in the training “Media and youth employment” in Petrovac, organised by the NGO Prima.
content_en:
Cooperation between the media and the NGO sector is key to promoting young people's safety and health at work
From 14 to 16 October the training “Media and youth employment” was held in Petrovac, organised by the NGO Prima; the Occupational Safety Association of Montenegro was represented by project coordinator Đina Janković.
The training was organised under the project “Western Balkans and Turkey for EmploYouth” and the Youth HUB network for the Western Balkans and Türkiye.
The aim of the training was to emphasise the importance of communication and of increasing the visibility of EU-financed projects, so that the desired objectives and project results can be achieved as well and as effectively as possible — in this case, motivating young people to complete the survey UZNR CG is running in order to collect data on young people's awareness of occupational safety and health, on the number of injuries they have suffered at work and on occupational diseases, and on whether they were able to exercise their rights.
That data will make it possible to have a more realistic picture of the state of this field and of the number of young people working in the grey economy.
One of the main “tools” for achieving that goal was identified as the media and the role they play in society in creating a preventive culture and informing citizens, and also their influence on decision-makers.
The training also presented the Youth Participation Index 2020 for the Western Balkans and Türkiye, with particular reference to Montenegro.
Through its activities under the project “Decent work starts while you are young” — through the educational handbook it has produced and through lectures in secondary vocational schools and at faculties — the Occupational Safety Association of Montenegro will help raise young people's awareness. In this way young people will be given the information they need to be better prepared for their first experience of work, and to understand the rights and duties they have in relation to fair working practice and labour rights.
UZNR CG will also inform the public and decision-makers properly for the purposes of advocacy.
