title: Predavanje u Srednjoj elektrotehničkoj školi „Vaso Aligrudić“
excerpt: UZNR CG i NVO MADOP realizovali su 13. oktobra 2022. treće po redu predavanje o zaštiti i zdravlju na radu za učenike Elektrotehničke škole „Vaso Aligrudić“ u Podgorici.
content:
Udruženje zaštite na radu Crne Gore je, u saradnji sa NVO MADOP, 13.10.2022. godine realizovalo treće po redu predavanje iz oblasti zaštite i zdravlja na radu, za đake Elektrotehničke škole „Vaso Aligrudić“ u Podgorici.
Predavači iz NVO MADOP su upoznali učenike aa brojnim opasnim materijama koje su prisutne u elektronskoj industriji, kao i u elektronskom otpadu. Akcenat je bio na upoznavanju s brojnim teškim metalima, koji mogu predstavljati rizik na njihovim budućim radnim mjestima, kako s aspwkta zdravlja zaposlenih, tako i s aspekta životne sredine.
Budući elektrotehničari, elektromonteri, elektroinstalateri, autoelektričari i elektrotehničari elektronike i energetike, kroz svoje obrazovanje ne stiču znanja iz oblasti zaštite i zdravlja na radu, pa o rizicima sa kojima će se svakodnevno susretati na svojim budućim radnim mjestima - 𝐧𝐞 𝐳𝐧𝐚𝐣𝐮 𝐠𝐨𝐭𝐨𝐯𝐨 𝐧𝐢š𝐭𝐚 – što su pokazali rezultati sprovedene ankete među učenicima ove škole.
Prethodno navedeno mora poslužiti kao apel Ministarstvu prosvjete za neophodnost uvođenja zaštite i zdravlja na radu u obrazovni sistem.
Sektor energetike zapošljava preko tri hiljade ljudi, a spada u vrlo rizične s aspekta povređivanja. Iz tog razloga, cilj ove obuke je bio da učenici dobiju neophodne informacije o kategorijama radova u električnim postrojenjima, organizacionim mjerama zaštite pri radovima u EEO, kao i mjerama ZZNR na osnovu utvrđenih rizika.
Mladi ljudi daju značajan doprinos društvu, kao produktivni radnici, potrošači, građani i pokretači promjena. Veoma često, pun potencijal mladih se ne realizuje zbog toga što su prinuđeni da obavljaju poslove koji ne ispunjavaju ni osnovne principe onoga što zovemo dostojanstvenim radom, kao i zbog nedovoljnog poznavanja pravila koja vladaju na tržištu rada i kojima se uređuju radni odnosi. Otuda i potreba da se podigne svijest mladih o značaju dostojanstvenog rada i njihovoj ulozi u njegovom ostvarivanju.
title_en: Lecture at the “Vaso Aligrudić” Secondary School of Electrical Engineering
excerpt_en: On 13 October 2022 UZNR CG and the NGO MADOP delivered their third lecture on occupational safety and health, for pupils of the “Vaso Aligrudić” School of Electrical Engineering in Podgorica.
content_en:
On 13 October 2022 the Occupational Safety Association of Montenegro, together with the NGO MADOP, delivered its third lecture on occupational safety and health, for pupils of the “Vaso Aligrudić” School of Electrical Engineering in Podgorica.
Lecturers from the NGO MADOP acquainted the pupils with the many hazardous substances present in the electronics industry and in electronic waste. The emphasis was on the many heavy metals that may pose a risk at their future workplaces, both to employees' health and to the environment.
Future electrical technicians, electrical fitters, electrical installers, auto electricians and technicians in electronics and energy acquire no knowledge of occupational safety and health during their education, so about the risks they will meet every day at their future workplaces they 𝐤𝐧𝐨𝐰 𝐚𝐥𝐦𝐨𝐬𝐭 𝐧𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠 — as the results of the survey among the school's pupils showed.
This must serve as an appeal to the Ministry of Education on the need to introduce occupational safety and health into the education system.
The energy sector employs more than three thousand people and is among the riskiest for injury. For that reason, the aim of this session was to give pupils the information they need about the categories of work in electrical installations, the organisational protective measures for work on electrical power equipment, and the occupational safety and health measures based on the risks identified.
Young people make a significant contribution to society, as productive workers, consumers, citizens and drivers of change. Very often young people's full potential is not realised because they are forced to do jobs that meet not even the basic principles of what we call decent work, and because they know too little about the rules that govern the labour market and employment relationships. Hence the need to raise young people's awareness of the importance of decent work and of their own role in achieving it.

title: Predavanje na Građevinskom fakultetu u Podgorici (2022)
excerpt: UZNR CG je 12. oktobra 2022, u saradnji sa NVO MADOP, održalo drugo po redu predavanje o zaštiti i zdravlju na radu za studente Građevinskog fakulteta u Podgorici.
content:
Udruženje zaštite na radu Crne Gore je, u saradnji sa NVO MADOP uspješno realizovalo drugo po redu predavanje iz oblasti zaštite i zdravlja na radu za studente Građevinskog fakulteta u Podgorici!
Cilj ovih predavanja, koja se, u okviru projekta „Dostojanstven rad počinje dok si mlad“, organizuju u saradnji sa NVO Prima i uz finansijsku podršku Evropske komisije, je da se mladi ljudi upoznaju sa osnovnim načelima zaštite i zdravlja na radu, njihovim pravima i odgovornostima koje imaju kada zasnuju radni odnos, ali i obavezama i odgovornostima koje poslodavci imaju prema njima kao svojim zaposlenima.
Eksperti iz NVO MADOP su nastojali da buduće gtađevinske inženjere upoznaju sa rizicima do kojih dovodi rad sa opasnim materijama s aspekta zdravlja zaposlenih u građevinskom sektoru, ali i rizicima po životnu sredinu, do kojih dovodi neadekvatno odlaganje građevinskog otpada.
Budući da u Crnoj Gori nemamo podataka o broju mladih ljudi koji su doživjeli povredu na radu ili dobili neko profesionalno oboljenje, prije predavanja sprovodimo anketiranje studenata kroz popunjavanje upitnika, s ciljem da steknemo što realniju sliku o stanju u ovoj oblasti, ali i o nivou njihovog znanja o zaštiti i zdravlju na radu.
Rezulati anketiranja su poražavajući – pokazuju veoma nizak nivo znanja iz oblasti zaštite i zdravlja na radu studenata koji se obrazuju i pripremaju za tržište rada i veoma odgovorne poslove inženjera u sektoru građevinarstva.
Napomena: Građevinski sektor je najrazvijenija industrijska grana u Crnoj Gori koja zapošljava između 17 i 20 hiljada ljudi, ali istovremeno i najrizičnija s aspekta bezbjednosti, na šta podsjeća podatak da je u prošloj godini na crnogorskim gradilištima život izgubilo 7 ljudi, a broj povrijeđenih je ogroman.
Ovo potvrđuje neophodnost uvođenja zaštite i zdravlja na radu u obrazovni sistem Crne Gore kako bismo spriječili da mladi ljudi, budući nosioci razvoja našeg društva, zbog neinformisanosti budu neadekvatno zaštićeni na radnom mjestu.
title_en: Lecture at the Faculty of Civil Engineering in Podgorica (2022)
excerpt_en: On 12 October 2022, together with the NGO MADOP, UZNR CG delivered its second lecture on occupational safety and health, for students of the Faculty of Civil Engineering in Podgorica.
content_en:
The Occupational Safety Association of Montenegro, together with the NGO MADOP, successfully delivered its second lecture on occupational safety and health for students of the Faculty of Civil Engineering in Podgorica.
The aim of these lectures, organised under the project “Decent work starts while you are young” in cooperation with the NGO Prima and with financial support from the European Commission, is to acquaint young people with the basic principles of occupational safety and health, with the rights and responsibilities they will have when they enter employment, and with the obligations and responsibilities employers have towards them as employees.
Experts from the NGO MADOP sought to acquaint future civil engineers with the risks that working with hazardous substances poses to the health of employees in the construction sector, and with the environmental risks arising from the inadequate disposal of construction waste.
Since Montenegro has no data on the number of young people who have suffered an injury at work or contracted an occupational disease, we survey students by questionnaire before the lecture, in order to gain as realistic a picture as possible of the state of this field and of their level of knowledge about occupational safety and health.
The survey results are dispiriting — they show a very low level of knowledge of occupational safety and health among students who are being educated and prepared for the labour market and for the highly responsible work of engineers in construction.
Note: construction is the most developed industrial sector in Montenegro, employing between 17,000 and 20,000 people, but at the same time the riskiest from a safety point of view — a reminder of which is the fact that last year 7 people lost their lives on Montenegrin construction sites, and the number of injuries is enormous.
This confirms the need to introduce occupational safety and health into Montenegro's education system, so that young people, the future bearers of our society's development, are not inadequately protected at work through lack of information.

title: Predavanje u JU „Srednja stručna škola“ u Nikšiću (2022)
excerpt: UZNR CG i NVO MADOP održali su 11. oktobra 2022. prvu radionicu o zaštiti i zdravlju na radu za učenike završnih razreda Srednje stručne škole u Nikšiću.
content:
Uspješno je realizovana prva radionica u JU „Srednja stručna škola“ u Nikšiću, za učenike završnih razreda 3. i 4. stepena!
Udruženje zaštite na radu Crne Gore je, u saradnji s NVO MADOP, upoznalo učenike sa osnovnim načelima zaštite i zdravlja na radu, njihovim pravima i odgovornostima koje imaju kada zasnuju radni odnos, ali i obavezama i odgovornostima koje poslodavci imaju prema njima kao svojim zaposlenima.
Cilj ovih obuka, koje se realizuju u okviru projekta „Dostojanstven rad počinje dok si mlad“, je podizanje svijesti mladih ljudi o postojanju odgovornosti i potrebe za dostojanstvenom radnom praksom i pružanje pomoći mladima da identifikuju ulogu koju oni sami – kao budući učesnici radnog procesa – imaju u promovisanju i održanju pravednog radnog odnosa.
Stručnjaci za opasne materije, iz NVO MADOP su sa učenicima razgovarali o brojnim rizicima koje izlaganje ooasnim materijama nosi, posebno s aspekta zaštite zdravlja zaposlenih, ali i očuvanja životne sredine.
Ukoliko se mladima obezbijede informacije koje su im potrebne oni će biti bolje pripremljeni za svoje prvo radno iskustvo i razumjeće svoja prava i dužnosti u odnosu na pravednu radnu praksu i radna prava.
Zaključak: Veoma nizak nivo znanja i informisanosti učenika, koji se obrazuju i pripremaju za tržište rada i poslove u sektoru energetike, koji spadaja u najrizičnije s aspekta bezbjednosti, potvrđuje neophodnost uvođenja zaštite i zdravlja na radu u obrazovni sistem Crne Gore.
title_en: Lecture at the Secondary Vocational School in Nikšić (2022)
excerpt_en: On 11 October 2022 UZNR CG and the NGO MADOP held their first workshop on occupational safety and health for final-year pupils of the Secondary Vocational School in Nikšić.
content_en:
The first workshop at the Secondary Vocational School in Nikšić, for final-year pupils at levels 3 and 4, was successfully delivered.
The Occupational Safety Association of Montenegro, together with the NGO MADOP, acquainted pupils with the basic principles of occupational safety and health, with the rights and responsibilities they will have when they enter employment, and with the obligations and responsibilities employers have towards them as employees.
The aim of these sessions, delivered under the project “Decent work starts while you are young”, is to raise young people's awareness that responsibility and decent working practice exist and are needed, and to help young people identify the role they themselves — as future participants in the world of work — play in promoting and maintaining fair employment relationships.
Specialists in hazardous substances from the NGO MADOP discussed with the pupils the many risks that exposure to hazardous substances carries, particularly for employees' health but also for the environment.
If young people are given the information they need, they will be better prepared for their first experience of work and will understand their rights and duties in relation to fair working practice and labour rights.
Conclusion: the very low level of knowledge and awareness among pupils who are being educated and prepared for the labour market and for work in the energy sector — among the riskiest from a safety point of view — confirms the need to introduce occupational safety and health into Montenegro's education system.

title: Poziv za drugi dio regionalne obuke o izgradnji kapaciteta OCD
excerpt: Nakon uspješno održanog prvog dijela u Budvi, UZNR CG je objavilo poziv za drugi dio regionalne radionice o jačanju kapaciteta aktera za sprovođenje propisa o zaštiti i zdravlju na radu, zakazan za 26–28. oktobar 2022.
content:
Poziv za regionalnu obuku: Izgradnja kapaciteta organizacija civilnog društva i ključnih aktera za sprovođenje i monitoring postojećih propisa zaštite i zdravlja na radu i uslova rada
Udruženje zaštite na radu Crne Gore (UZNR CG), u okviru projekta „Poboljšanje uslova rada i zaštite i zdravlja na radu, kao podrška zemljama Zapadnog Balkana u procesu pristupanja Evropskoj uniji“ u okviru Ugovora o grantu, IPA/2019/413-810, i član regionalne mreže za zaštitu i zdravlje na radu BALcanOSH.net, poziva Vas da prisustvujete obukama za jačanje kapaciteta organizacija civilnog društva i ključnih aktera za sprovođenje i praćenje postojećih propisa o zaštiti i zdravlju na radu.
Cilj projekta: Jačanje uticaja organizacija civilnog društva u regionu za efikasno i odgovorno učešće u procesima politike i reformama u oblasti zaštite i zdravlja na radu u zemljama Zapadnog Balkana.
Specifični cilj projekta: Dinamičnije civilno društvo kroz umrežavanje, zagovaranje, dugoročno strateško organizaciono planiranje i podsticanje nivoa uključenosti i uključivanja organizacija civilnog društva u procese donošenja odluka u vezi sa bezbjednim uslovima rada.
Zadovoljstvo nam je da objavimo poziv za učešće na regionalnoj tematskoj radionici za jačanje kapaciteta ključnih aktera uključenih u sprovođenje propisa o zaštiti i zdravlju na radu i uslovima rada.
Na prvom dijelu radionice koja je održana u periodu od 05. do 07. oktobra 2022. godine učestvovalo je 20 predstavnika sindikata, poslodavaca, doktora medicine rada, obrazovnih institucija, stručnih lica za zaštitu i zdravlje na radu i zaposlenih.
Drugi dio obuke će se održati u Budvi u periodu od 26. do 28. oktobra 2022. godine.
Rok za podnošenje prijave je 21. oktobar do 16 časova.
POZIV ZA UČEŠĆE
AGENDA
title_en: Call for the second part of the regional training on building CSO capacity
excerpt_en: After a successful first part in Budva, UZNR CG published a call for the second part of the regional workshop on strengthening the capacity of actors to implement occupational safety and health regulations, scheduled for 26–28 October 2022.
content_en:
Call for regional training: Building the capacity of civil society organisations and key actors to implement and monitor the existing regulations on occupational safety and health and on working conditions
The Occupational Safety Association of Montenegro (UZNR CG), under the project “Improving working conditions and occupational safety and health in support of the Western Balkan countries in the EU accession process”, grant agreement IPA/2019/413-810, and as a member of the regional occupational safety and health network BALcanOSH.net, invites you to attend training aimed at strengthening the capacity of civil society organisations and key actors to implement and monitor the existing occupational safety and health regulations.
Aim of the project: to strengthen the influence of civil society organisations in the region so that they take part effectively and responsibly in policy processes and reform in occupational safety and health in the countries of the Western Balkans.
Specific objective of the project: a more dynamic civil society through networking, advocacy and long-term strategic organisational planning, and through encouraging the involvement and inclusion of civil society organisations in decision-making on safe working conditions.
We are pleased to announce a call for participation in a regional thematic workshop to strengthen the capacity of the key actors involved in implementing regulations on occupational safety and health and on working conditions.
The first part of the workshop, held from 5 to 7 October 2022, was attended by 20 representatives of trade unions, employers, occupational medicine doctors, educational institutions, occupational safety and health professionals and employees.
The second part of the training will be held in Budva from 26 to 28 October 2022.
The deadline for applications is 21 October at 16:00.
CALL FOR PARTICIPATION
AGENDA

title: Regionalna radionica „Izgradnja kapaciteta organizacija civilnog društva“ – prvi dio
excerpt: UZNR CG je u saradnji sa BALcanOSH mrežom u Budvi, od 5. do 7. oktobra 2022, organizovalo prvi dio regionalne radionice o jačanju kapaciteta ključnih aktera za sprovođenje propisa o zaštiti i zdravlju na radu.
content:
Regionalna radionica „Izgradnja kapaciteta organizacija civilnog društva i ključnih aktera za sprovođenje i monitoring postojećih propisa zaštite i zdravlja na radu i uslova rada“
Udruženje zaštite na radu Crne Gore je, u saradnji sa BALcanOSH mrežom, organizovalo prvi dio Regionalne radionice „Izgradnja kapaciteta organizacija civilnog društva i ključnih aktera za sprovođenje i monitoring postojećih propisa zaštite i zdravlja na radu i uslova rada, u Budvi, u periodu od 05. do 07. oktobra 2022. godine.
Obuka je održana za predstavnike sindikata, poslodavaca, doktora medicine rada, stručnih lica za zaštitu i zdravlje na radu i zaposlenih, u okviru projekta „Poboljšanje uslova rada i zaštite i zdravlja na radu, kao podrška zemljama Zapadnog Balkana u procesu pristupanja Evropskoj uniji“.
Cilj projekta: Jačanje uticaja organizacija civilnog društva u regionu za efikasno i odgovorno učešće u procesima politike i reformama u oblasti zaštite i zdravlja na radu u zemljama Zapadnog Balkana.
Specifični cilj projekta: Dinamičnije civilno društvo kroz umrežavanje, zagovaranje, dugoročno strateško organizaciono planiranje i podsticanje nivoa uključenosti i uključivanja organizacija civilnog društva u procese donošenja odluka u vezi sa bezbjednim uslovima rada.
Cilj ove obuke je bilo jačanje kapaciteta ključnih aktera uključenih u sprovođenje propisa o zaštiti i zdravlju na radu i uslovima rada, ali i predlaganje rješenja za postizanje šest strateških ciljeva, koji su prepoznati kao ključni u strategiji razvoja zaštite i zdravlja na radu u regionu do 2023. godine:
1. Efikasan pravni okvir (politike ZZNR)
2. Edukacija/sistem obrazovanja ZZNR
3. Jačanje kapaciteta ZZNR
4. Promocija i podizanje javne svijesti o ZZNR
5. Evidencije ZZNR (povrede na radu i profesionalna oboljenja)
6. Sektorska i međusektorska saradnja
Dvadeset dvoje učesnika je iznosilo svoja zapažanja i brojne izazove i probleme s kojima se svakodnevno suočavaju kao zaposleni, poslodavci, doktori medicine rada i stručna lica.
Svi prisutni su bili saglasni oko činjenice da je nacionalna zakonska regulativa usklađena sa neophodnim direktivama, međutim ono što nedostaje u Crnoj Gori je efikasna i dosljedna primjena pravnog okvira, dok je za adekvatnu implementaciju neophodan veći stepen odgovornosti.
Neinformisanost i nedostatak edukacije je prepoznat kao jedan od ključnih problema, posmatrano iz ugla poslodavaca, pri čemu su oni takođe iznijeli primjedbu da nisu dovoljno stimulisani od strane države, jer uz brojne „namete“ ovo je za njih samo još jedna biznis barijera. Primijetili su, takođe, da ukoliko bi na vrijeme i na pravi načini bili informisani o benefitima ove vrste ulaganja u svoje zaposlene, ne bi imali ništa protiv da ulažu u ZZNR. Predložili su da bi najbolji način za upoznavanje poslodavaca sa zakonskim obavezama iz ove oblasti trebalo da bude prilikom registrovanja firme, kada bi im bile dostavljane relevantne informacije, ali i zahtijevano od njih da posjeduju svu neophodnu dokumentaciju iz oblasti zaštite i zdravlja na radu, što bi im bio uslov za obavljanje djelatnosti.
Jedan dio učesnika je, kao jedan od problema, iznio zapažanje da sindikati ne obavljaju svoju ulogu s aspekta bezbjednog rada, a razlog vide u needukovanosti sindikalnih predstavnika o pravima zaposlenih, kao i o obavezama i odgovornostima poslodavaca kada je u pitanju ZZNR. Osim edukacije o zaštiti i zdravlju na radu, naveli su da je neophodna i edukacija zaposlenih i predstavnika zaposlenih o uspješnom pokretanju socijalnog dijaloga.
Kao poseban problem, karakterističan za Crnu Goru, prepoznata je nezainteresovanost zaposlenih da se sindikalno organizuju, usljed straha od represivnih mjera u vidu disciplinskog postupka i otkaza.
Predloženo je da se u većoj mjeri rade i primjenjuju komparativne analize i dobre prakse onih zemalja gdje to funkcioniše, ali i kontinuirana saradnja na bipartitan nivou između poslodavca i zaposlenih.
U praksi veliki problem predstavlja to što ljekari, iz razloga što ne žele da preuzmu tu vrstu odgovornosti, vrlo često ne popunjavaju četvrtu stranu povredne liste. Predloženo je da bi bilo neophodno naći način da se ljekari na neki način stimulišu da bi prijavili povredu na radu koju su konstatovali.
S aspekta nemogućnosti dokazivanja uzroka oboljevanja usljed izloženosti određenim štetnim uticajima na radnom mjestu, što je dovelo do toga da u Crnoj Gori nije registrovano ni jedno profesionalno oboljenje od 2015. godine - po mišljenju doktora medicine rada, najrealnije bi bilo obnavljanje saradnje sa Institutom za medicinu rada Dr Dragomir Karajović ili uspostavljanje saradnje sa nekim drugim institutom u regionu. Naglasili su da za formiranje Zavoda za medicinu rada u Crnoj Gori ne postoje adekvatni uslovi, prvenstveno kadrovi, i da bi planiranje takvog projekta bilo neracionalno.
Prisutni su naveli brojne primjere ljudi iz svog okruženja/kolega, koji su oboljeli od različitih bolesti uzrokovanih uslovima radne sredine, a jedan od primjera je slučaj šestoro zaposlenih u KCCG-u, na odjeljenju patologije, oboljelih od TBC-a, pa je, shodno tome, u narednom periodu nephodno staviti akcenat na iznalaženje načina za rješavanje problema sa aspekta profesionalnih oboljenja i bolesti u vezi sa radom.
Doveden je u pitanje kvalitet zdravstvenih pregleda zaposlenih, s obzirom na to da su iznijeti brojni primjeri koji ukazuju na to da se pregledi vrlo često rade „pro forma“, a razlog tome je nepostojanje kontrole rada doktora medicine rada. Ovo potvrđuje i činjenica da u Crnoj Gori ima 17 javnih zdravstvenih ustanova i 12 privatnih, a ukupno 12 doktora medicine rada (koliko ih po pretpostavci ima u Crnoj Gori) obavlja poslove u tih 29 ustanova.
Predloženo je osnivanje nacionalnog osiguravajućeg društva i funkcionisanje istog po principu koji je nekada postojao, a podrazumijevao je odvajanje 0,5 % zarade namijenjenih za osiguranje od povreda i profesionalnih bolesti. Pomenuti procenat zarade bi se preusmjeravao upravo u to akcionarsko društvo, koje bi 51% bilo u vlasništvu države.
Ugovori o djelu su, po tvrdnji inspektora rada za oblast ZZNR potpuno van sistema, ali čak i u slučajevima kad neko obavlja dopunski rad, mora biti osiguran. Inspektori se u praksi susreću i sa problemom termina „upućeni stranac“, kada su u pitanju zaposleni koji dolaze iz inostranstva.
Takođe, u smislu izvještavanja EK, inspektorima predstavlja veliki izazov definisanje pojma „preduzetnik“. Naime, u smislu Zakona o djelatnosti preduzetnika, preduzetnik je fizičko lice koje obavlja djelatnost radi sticanja dobiti, ali takođe zapošljava radnike u skladu sa zakonom, što nije u skladu s definicijom „self-employed“, koji poznaje EU.
U praksi se inspektori često susreću sa problemima u slučajevima kada je država investitor, a dođe do povrede na radu, pri čemu taj investitor nije upoznat sa svojim zakonskim obavezama. Problem se javlja i zbog nedefinisanih nadležnosti i Zakona o državnim službenicima i nameštenicima, koji se u tim slučajevima primjenjuje, pa nadležnost ima Upravna inspekcija, a ne Inspekcija rada za oblast ZZNR.
Neki od izazova su i pronalaženje načina da se motivišu poslodavci da upućuju svoje zaposlene na periodične ljekarske preglede, da se pronađu mehanizmi kontrole kvaliteta procjene rizika, kao i da se na efikasniji način utvrdi uloga stručnog lica koje bi moralo ukazivati poslodavcu na ispunjavanje uslova radne sredine.
Prisutni su, shodno navedenim brojnim problemima u ovoj oblasti, bili saglasni da postoji potreba za osnivanjem zavoda ili komore za zaštitu i zdravlje na radu koja bi se, između ostalog, bavila istraživanjima o tome kako proces rada utiče na zdravlje zaposlenih, a detektovanje slabosti, i pronalaženje načina za njihovo eliminisanje, uz jasno definisane nadležnosti i praćenje realizacije u praksi, je jedini način za postizanje rezultata koji imaju za cilj unapređenje oblasti zaštite i zdravlja na radu u Crnoj Gori.
title_en: Regional workshop “Building the capacity of civil society organisations” – part one
excerpt_en: Together with the BALcanOSH network, UZNR CG held the first part of a regional workshop on strengthening key actors' capacity to implement occupational safety and health regulations in Budva from 5 to 7 October 2022.
content_en:
Regional workshop “Building the capacity of civil society organisations and key actors to implement and monitor the existing regulations on occupational safety and health and on working conditions”
The Occupational Safety Association of Montenegro, together with the BALcanOSH network, organised the first part of the regional workshop “Building the capacity of civil society organisations and key actors to implement and monitor the existing regulations on occupational safety and health and on working conditions” in Budva from 5 to 7 October 2022.
The training was held for representatives of trade unions, employers, occupational medicine doctors, occupational safety and health professionals and employees, under the project “Improving working conditions and occupational safety and health in support of the Western Balkan countries in the EU accession process”.
Aim of the project: to strengthen the influence of civil society organisations in the region so that they take part effectively and responsibly in policy processes and reform in occupational safety and health in the countries of the Western Balkans.
Specific objective of the project: a more dynamic civil society through networking, advocacy and long-term strategic organisational planning, and through encouraging the involvement and inclusion of civil society organisations in decision-making on safe working conditions.
The aim of this training was to strengthen the capacity of the key actors involved in implementing regulations on occupational safety and health and on working conditions, and to propose ways of achieving the six strategic objectives identified as key in the strategy for developing occupational safety and health in the region up to 2023:
1. An effective legal framework (OSH policy)
2. OSH education and the education system
3. Strengthening OSH capacity
4. Promotion and public awareness of OSH
5. OSH records (injuries at work and occupational diseases)
6. Sectoral and cross-sectoral cooperation
Twenty-two participants shared their observations and the many challenges and problems they face every day as employees, employers, occupational medicine doctors and safety professionals.
Everyone present agreed that national legislation is aligned with the necessary directives, but that what is missing in Montenegro is effective, consistent application of the legal framework, and that proper implementation requires a greater degree of accountability.
Lack of information and of education was identified as one of the key problems from the employers' point of view; they also objected that they are insufficiently encouraged by the state, since alongside the many “levies” this is for them merely another barrier to doing business. They also noted that if they were informed in good time and in the right way about the benefits of this kind of investment in their employees, they would have no objection to investing in OSH. They suggested that the best way to acquaint employers with their legal obligations in this field would be at the point of registering a company, when they could be given the relevant information and required to hold all the necessary occupational safety and health documentation as a condition of operating.
Some participants observed, as a problem, that trade unions do not fulfil their role as regards safe work, the reason being that union representatives are not educated about employees' rights or about employers' obligations and responsibilities in OSH. Besides education about occupational safety and health, they said education for employees and employees' representatives on successfully initiating social dialogue is also needed.
A particular problem, characteristic of Montenegro, was identified as employees' reluctance to organise in trade unions, for fear of reprisals in the form of disciplinary proceedings and dismissal.
It was proposed that comparative analyses and the good practice of countries where this works be produced and applied to a greater degree, along with continuous bipartite cooperation between employer and employees.
A major problem in practice is that doctors, unwilling to take on that kind of responsibility, very often do not complete the fourth page of the injury report. It was proposed that a way be found to give doctors some incentive to report an injury at work they have identified.
As regards the impossibility of proving that an illness was caused by exposure to particular harmful influences at the workplace — which has led to no occupational disease being registered in Montenegro since 2015 — occupational medicine doctors take the view that the most realistic course would be to renew cooperation with the Dr Dragomir Karajović Institute of Occupational Medicine or to establish cooperation with another institute in the region. They emphasised that the conditions for establishing an institute of occupational medicine in Montenegro do not exist, primarily as regards staff, and that planning such a project would be irrational.
Participants gave numerous examples of people around them and colleagues who have fallen ill with various diseases caused by conditions in the working environment; one example is the case of six employees in the pathology department of the Clinical Centre of Montenegro who contracted TB. In the period ahead, therefore, emphasis must be placed on finding ways to solve the problem of occupational diseases and work-related illnesses.
The quality of employees' medical examinations was called into question, given the numerous examples cited indicating that examinations are very often done pro forma, the reason being that there is no oversight of occupational medicine doctors' work. This is confirmed by the fact that Montenegro has 17 public health institutions and 12 private ones, with a total of 12 occupational medicine doctors (as many as there are thought to be in Montenegro) working across those 29 institutions.
It was proposed that a national insurance company be established and operate on the principle that once existed, whereby 0.5% of earnings was set aside for insurance against injuries and occupational diseases. That percentage of earnings would be directed into precisely such a joint-stock company, 51% of which would be state-owned.
Service contracts are, according to the labour inspector for OSH, entirely outside the system, but even where someone does supplementary work they must be insured. In practice inspectors also encounter the problem of the term “posted foreign national” in the case of employees coming from abroad.
Also, for the purposes of reporting to the European Commission, defining the term “entrepreneur” is a major challenge for inspectors. Under the Law on Entrepreneurial Activity, an entrepreneur is a natural person who carries on an activity for profit but who also employs workers in accordance with the law, which does not match the EU's definition of “self-employed”.
In practice inspectors often encounter problems where the state is the investor and an injury at work occurs, with that investor unaware of its legal obligations. A problem also arises from undefined competences and from the Law on Civil Servants and State Employees, which applies in such cases, so that competence lies with the Administrative Inspectorate rather than with the Labour Inspectorate for OSH.
Other challenges include finding ways to motivate employers to send their employees for periodic medical examinations, finding mechanisms to control the quality of risk assessments, and establishing more effectively the role of the safety professional, who ought to be alerting the employer to the conditions the working environment must meet.
In view of these many problems, participants agreed that there is a need to establish an institute or chamber for occupational safety and health which would, among other things, research how the work process affects employees' health. Detecting weaknesses and finding ways to eliminate them, with clearly defined competences and monitoring of implementation in practice, is the only way to achieve results aimed at improving occupational safety and health in Montenegro.

title: Sastanak u Zavodu za zapošljavanje Crne Gore
excerpt: Generalna sekretarka UZNR CG Đina Janković sastala se 29. septembra 2022. sa šeficom Zavoda za zapošljavanje Crne Gore Dragicom Šćekić radi dogovora o edukaciji nezaposlenih mladih.
content:
Đina Janković, generalna sekretarka i projektna koordinatorka Udruženja zaštite na radu Crne Gore je 29.09.2022. godine imala sastanak sa šeficom Zavoda za zapošljavanje Crne Gore Dragicom Šćekić.
Razgovarale su o mogućnosti uspostavljanja saradnje u cilju edukacije mladih koji se nalaze na evidenciji ZZZCG, o osnovnim pravima, obavezama i odgovornostima s kojima treba da budu upoznati, prije stupanja u radni odnos, a koja se odnose na zaštitu i zdravlje na radu.
Budući da ZZZCG već organizuje brojne edukacije, obuke iz oblasti zaštite i zdravlja na radu bi bile korak više koji bi mladima pružio neophodna znanja iz ove oblasti.
U prilog tome ide i činjenica da je ZZZCG uključen u program Garancije za mlade, koji je još uvijek u početnoj fazi u Crnoj Gori. Ovaj program obuhvata mlade koji imaju između 15 i 30 godina, a posebnu pažnju treba posvetiti i pitanju onih mladih koji se karakterišu kao NEET – mladi koji imaju između 15 i 30 godina, a koji nisu ni zaposleni, ne obrazuju se, niti se usavršavaju (Not in Employment, Education or Training), a koji su ciljna grupa projekta „Dostojanstven rad počinje dok si mlad“, koji realizuje Udruženje zaštite na radu Crne Gore.
Istraživanja pokazuju da je 2019. broj NEET mladih u EU iznosio 212 hiljada.
Funkcionisanje Garancija za mlade podrazumijeva obavezu saradnje sa organizacijama koje se bave pitanjima mladih, a jedino na taj način će biti moguće da program Garancija funkcioniše na najbolji mogući način i – što je još važnije – da da rezultate koji to dokazuju.
U narednom periodu će biti organizovan sastanak sa direktorom ZZZCG g-dinom Goranom Folićem u cilju uspostavljanja saradnje i mogućnosti distribucije priručnika „Šta mladi treba da znaju o zaštiti i zdravlju na radu“ u područnim jedinicama Zavoda za zapošljavanje Crne Gore.
title_en: Meeting at the Employment Agency of Montenegro
excerpt_en: On 29 September 2022 UZNR CG's secretary general Đina Janković met the head of the Employment Agency of Montenegro, Dragica Šćekić, to discuss education for unemployed young people.
content_en:
On 29 September 2022 Đina Janković, secretary general and project coordinator of the Occupational Safety Association of Montenegro, met the head of the Employment Agency of Montenegro, Dragica Šćekić.
They discussed the scope for cooperating on educating young people on the Agency's register about the basic rights, obligations and responsibilities relating to occupational safety and health that they should know about before entering employment.
Since the Agency already organises a great deal of training, courses in occupational safety and health would be a further step giving young people the knowledge they need in this field.
This is supported by the fact that the Agency is involved in the Youth Guarantee programme, still at an early stage in Montenegro. The programme covers young people aged between 15 and 30, and particular attention should also be paid to those classed as NEET — young people between 15 and 30 who are not in employment, education or training — who are the target group of the project “Decent work starts while you are young”, carried out by the Occupational Safety Association of Montenegro.
Research shows that in 2019 there were 212,000 NEET young people in the EU.
The Youth Guarantee requires cooperation with organisations working on youth issues, and only in that way will it be possible for the Guarantee programme to function as well as it can and — more importantly — to produce results that prove it.
In the period ahead a meeting will be organised with the Agency's director, Goran Folić, with a view to establishing cooperation and to the possibility of distributing the handbook “What young people should know about occupational safety and health” through the Employment Agency's regional offices.

title: Sastanak u Ministarstvu prosvjete (2022)
excerpt: Đina Janković razgovarala je 22. septembra 2022. sa državnom sekretarkom Ministarstva prosvjete Milijanom Vukotić Jelušić o mogućnosti uvođenja zaštite i zdravlja na radu u nastavne programe srednjih škola.
content:
Đina Janković, generalna sekretarka i projektna koordinatorka Udruženja zaštite na radu Crne Gore razgovarala je 22. septembra 2022. godine sa državnom sekretarkom Ministarstva prosvjete Milijanom Vukotić Jelušić, o mogućnosti saradnje Udruženja i Ministarstva i uvođenja predmeta zaštite i zdravlja na radu u vaspitno-obrazovni proces u srednjim školama.
Nacionalnom Strategijom za unaprjeđenje zaštite i zdravlja na radu za period 2022-2027. koju je donijelo Ministarstvo rada i socijalnog staranja, predviđeno je uvođenje zaštite i zdravlja na radu u obrazovni program.
Naše udruženje trenutno realizuje projekat „Dostojanstven rad počinje dok si mlad“, koji finansira Evropska komisija, a kojim nastojimo doprinijeti podizanju svijesti mladih ljudi o važnosti stupanja u radni odnos po osnovu ugovora o radu i prednostima koje takav vid zapošljavanja nudi, posebno s aspekta povređivanja na radnom mjestu ili profesionalnih bolesti i bolesti u vezi s radom, odnosno izbjegavanja rizika koje zona sive/neformalne ekonomije nosi.
Budući da mladi ljudi zbog neinformisanosti o posljedicama, ali i benefitima formalnog zaposlenja, često nisu adekvatno zaštićeni na radnom mjestu, nerijetko dolazi do lakših, težih povreda i/ili trajnog invaliditeta - što ih čini nekonkurentnima i na duge staze ih udaljava sa tržišta rada.
Izgradnja kulture prevencije zaštite i zdravlja na radu je dinamičan proces koji zahtijeva posvećenost ključnih aktera. Djeca i omladina su budućnost svakog društva, te prema tome osnovno znanje o zaštiti i zdravlju na radu treba da bude integrisano u vaspitno-obrazovni sistem Crne Gore, kako bi osigurali za budućnost radnu snagu i stanovništvo koje je senzitivno i svjesno značaja zaštite i zdravlja, dok su u školi, na poslu i tokom svakodnevnog života.
Dobro obrazovanje o zaštiti i zdravlju na radu u školi treba da omogući učenicima da usvoje pozitivan odnos i ponašanje, kako bi stekli znanje, razvili vještine i sposobnosti da identifikuju opasnosti i rizike i nađu rešenja.
Tokom oktobra i novembra realizovaćemo obuke i radionice iz oblasti zaštite i zdravlja na radu za učenike u srednjim stručnim školama u Podgorici, Bijelom Polju i Nikšiću, a radionicama će prisustvovati i predstavnici Ministarstva prosvjete – Direktorata za srednje obrazovanje.
title_en: Meeting at the Ministry of Education (2022)
excerpt_en: On 22 September 2022 Đina Janković discussed with the Ministry of Education's state secretary, Milijana Vukotić Jelušić, the possibility of introducing occupational safety and health into secondary school curricula.
content_en:
On 22 September 2022 Đina Janković, secretary general and project coordinator of the Occupational Safety Association of Montenegro, discussed with the Ministry of Education's state secretary, Milijana Vukotić Jelušić, the scope for cooperation between the Association and the Ministry and for introducing occupational safety and health as a subject into secondary school education.
The National Strategy for Improving Occupational Safety and Health for 2022–2027, adopted by the Ministry of Labour and Social Welfare, provides for occupational safety and health to be introduced into the educational programme.
Our association is currently carrying out the project “Decent work starts while you are young”, financed by the European Commission, through which we seek to raise young people's awareness of the importance of entering employment under an employment contract and of the advantages such employment offers, particularly as regards injuries at work or occupational and work-related illnesses — that is, avoiding the risks that the grey or informal economy carries.
Since young people, unaware of both the consequences and the benefits of formal employment, are often not adequately protected at work, minor and serious injuries and/or permanent disability frequently occur, which makes them uncompetitive and pushes them out of the labour market in the long run.
Building a culture of prevention in occupational safety and health is a dynamic process requiring commitment from key actors. Children and young people are the future of any society, so basic knowledge of occupational safety and health should be integrated into Montenegro's education system, in order to secure for the future a workforce and a population that is sensitive to and aware of the importance of safety and health — at school, at work and in everyday life.
Good education about occupational safety and health at school should enable pupils to adopt a positive attitude and behaviour, so that they gain knowledge and develop the skills and ability to identify hazards and risks and find solutions.
During October and November we will deliver training and workshops on occupational safety and health for pupils in secondary vocational schools in Podgorica, Bijelo Polje and Nikšić; the workshops will also be attended by representatives of the Ministry of Education's Directorate for Secondary Education.

title: Poziv za regionalnu obuku o izgradnji kapaciteta OCD (septembar 2022)
excerpt: UZNR CG je 21. septembra 2022. objavilo poziv za učešće na regionalnoj radionici za jačanje kapaciteta aktera uključenih u sprovođenje propisa o zaštiti i zdravlju na radu, čiji je prvi dio zakazan za 5–7. oktobar u Budvi.
content:
Poziv za regionalnu obuku: Izgradnja kapaciteta organizacija civilnog društva i ključnih aktera za sprovođenje i monitoring postojećih propisa zaštite i zdravlja na radu i uslova rada
21.09.2022.
Udruženje zaštite na radu Crne Gore (UZNR CG), u okviru projekta „Poboljšanje uslova rada i zaštite i zdravlja na radu, kao podrška zemljama Zapadnog Balkana u procesu pristupanja Evropskoj uniji“ u okviru Ugovora o grantu, IPA/2019/413-810, i član regionalne mreže za zaštitu i zdravlje na radu BALcanOSH.net, poziva Vas da prisustvujete obukama za jačanje kapaciteta organizacija civilnog društva i ključnih aktera za sprovođenje i praćenje postojećih propisa o zaštiti i zdravlju na radu.
Cilj projekta: Jačanje uticaja organizacija civilnog društva u regionu za efikasno i odgovorno učešće u procesima politike i reformama u oblasti zaštite i zdravlja na radu u zemljama Zapadnog Balkana.
Specifični cilj projekta: Dinamičnije civilno društvo kroz umrežavanje, zagovaranje, dugoročno strateško organizaciono planiranje i podsticanje nivoa uključenosti i uključivanja organizacija civilnog društva u procese donošenja odluka u vezi sa bezbjednim uslovima rada.
Zadovoljstvo nam je da objavimo poziv za učešće na regionalnoj tematskoj radionici za jačanje kapaciteta ključnih aktera uključenih u sprovođenje propisa o zaštiti i zdravlju na radu i uslovima rada (sindikati, poslodavci, doktori medicine rada, obrazovne ustanove, stručna lica za zaštitu i zdravlje na radu, zaposleni).
Obuka će se održati u Budvi, u periodu od 05. do 07. oktobra 2022. godine.
Rok za podnošenje prijave je 30. septembar 2022. godine do 16 časova.

title_en: Call for regional training on building CSO capacity (September 2022)
excerpt_en: On 21 September 2022 UZNR CG published a call for participation in a regional workshop to strengthen the capacity of actors involved in implementing occupational safety and health regulations, with the first part scheduled for 5–7 October in Budva.
content_en:
Call for regional training: Building the capacity of civil society organisations and key actors to implement and monitor the existing regulations on occupational safety and health and on working conditions
21 September 2022
The Occupational Safety Association of Montenegro (UZNR CG), under the project “Improving working conditions and occupational safety and health in support of the Western Balkan countries in the EU accession process”, grant agreement IPA/2019/413-810, and as a member of the regional occupational safety and health network BALcanOSH.net, invites you to attend training aimed at strengthening the capacity of civil society organisations and key actors to implement and monitor the existing occupational safety and health regulations.
Aim of the project: to strengthen the influence of civil society organisations in the region so that they take part effectively and responsibly in policy processes and reform in occupational safety and health in the countries of the Western Balkans.
Specific objective of the project: a more dynamic civil society through networking, advocacy and long-term strategic organisational planning, and through encouraging the involvement and inclusion of civil society organisations in decision-making on safe working conditions.
We are pleased to announce a call for participation in a regional thematic workshop to strengthen the capacity of the key actors involved in implementing regulations on occupational safety and health and on working conditions (trade unions, employers, occupational medicine doctors, educational institutions, occupational safety and health professionals, employees).
The training will be held in Budva from 5 to 7 October 2022.
The deadline for applications is 30 September 2022 at 16:00.

title: Gostovanje u emisiji „Lice Podgorice“ na Gradskoj televiziji
excerpt: Đina Janković gostovala je 2. avgusta 2022. u emisiji „Lice Podgorice“ i govorila o zaštiti i zdravlju na radu pri visokim temperaturama i položaju mladih na tržištu rada.
content:
Razgovor o zaštiti i zdravlju na radu pri visokim temperaturama, kao i o položaju mladih na tržištu rada, sa našom Đinom Janković.
Radovi na otvorenom pri ekstremno visokim spoljnim temperaturama kada je temperatura iznad 36°C ne treba da se obavljaju – osim u slučajevima ozbiljne, neposredne i neizbježne opasnosti, kada su ugroženi ljudski životi i materijalna dobra od društvenog značaja.
Iako je ova preporuka unijeta u okvire pravne regulative kroz čak dva pravilnika, koji definišu mjere zaštite i zdravlja na radu na privremenim pokretnim gradilištima, kao i radnoj sredini i radnoj okolini, poslodavci je ne poštuju.
Shodno podacima Uprave za inspekcijske poslove od 01.06.2022. izrečena je SAMO JEDNA mjera zabrane rada po osnovu rada na ekstremno visokim spoljnim temperaturama.
Posebno su ugroženi zaposleni u:
• sektoru građevinarstva,
• komunalnoj djelatnosti,
• održavanju energetskih vodova,
• održavanju vodovodne mreže,
• izdavanju plažnog mobilijara i plažnim barovima,
• svi oni koji radne zadatke obavljaju na otvorenom.
Mladi od 15 do 30 godina su posebno ranjiva kategorija.
Svakodnevne prijave, koje mladi dostavljaju Udruženju zaštite na radu Crne Gore, ukazuju na zabrinjavajuće nepravilnosti, kršenje odredbi Zakona o zaštiti i zdravlju na radu, odnosno veoma slabu implementaciju.
Implementacija treba da bude djelotvornija, a svijest o pravima zaposlenih da se poveća.
Cilj projekta „Dostojanstven rad počinje dok si mlad“ je povećanje zapošljivosti mladih iz NEET kategorije, kroz podizanje svijesti o zaštiti i zdravlju na radu, kao i o rizicima koje nosi rad „na crno“.
Pošto mladima često nedostaju znanje i iskustvo o rizicima povezanim sa njihovim zadacima, informacije i obuke o zaštiti na radu tokom obrazovanja ključni su za smanjenje stope profesionalnih nezgoda među njima. Budući da obrazovanje ima ključnu ulogu u razvoju preventivne kulture, mnoge države su počele da uključuju osnovno obrazovanje o prevenciji rizika u programe osnovnih, srednjih škola i fakulteta.
Crna Gora je JEDINA zemlja u regionu koja nema zaštitu i zdravlje na radu u obrazovnom programu.

title_en: Appearance on “The Face of Podgorica” on Gradska Televizija
excerpt_en: On 2 August 2022 Đina Janković appeared on the programme “The Face of Podgorica” to discuss occupational safety and health in high temperatures and the position of young people on the labour market.
content_en:
A conversation with our Đina Janković about occupational safety and health in high temperatures and about the position of young people on the labour market.
Work outdoors in extremely high outside temperatures, when the temperature is above 36°C, should not be carried out — except where there is serious, immediate and unavoidable danger to human life or to material assets of social importance.
Although this recommendation has been written into the legal framework through no fewer than two rulebooks, defining occupational safety and health measures on temporary and mobile construction sites and in the working environment and surroundings, employers do not comply with it.
According to Administration of Inspection Affairs data, since 1 June 2022 only ONE prohibition of work has been issued on the grounds of work in extremely high outside temperatures.
Those particularly at risk are employees in:
• construction,
• municipal services,
• the maintenance of power lines,
• the maintenance of the water supply network,
• beach hire and beach bars,
• and everyone who works outdoors.
Young people aged 15 to 30 are a particularly vulnerable group.
The reports young people send the Occupational Safety Association of Montenegro every day point to worrying irregularities and breaches of the Law on Occupational Safety and Health — that is, to very weak implementation.
Implementation needs to be more effective, and awareness of employees' rights needs to increase.
The aim of the project “Decent work starts while you are young” is to increase the employability of young people in the NEET category by raising awareness of occupational safety and health and of the risks that undeclared work carries.
Since young people often lack knowledge and experience of the risks associated with their tasks, information and training about safety at work during their education is key to reducing the rate of occupational accidents among them. Because education plays a key role in developing a preventive culture, many countries have begun to include basic education about risk prevention in the curricula of primary and secondary schools and universities.
Montenegro is the ONLY country in the region without occupational safety and health in its educational programme.

title: Poziv za angažovanje predavača u okviru projekta „Dostojanstven rad počinje dok si mlad“
excerpt: UZNR CG je 8. jula 2022. pozvalo članove Udruženja, stručnjake za zaštitu i zdravlje na radu, da se prijave kao predavači na radionicama planiranim za srednje škole i fakultete tokom oktobra i novembra 2022.
content:
UZNR CG poziva eksperte iz oblasti zaštite i zdravlja na radu (članove Udruženja) za predavanja na edukativnim radionicima i obukama, koje će biti realizovane tokom oktobra i novembra 2022. godine, u srednjim stručnim školama u Podgorici, Bijelom Polju i Nikšiću, kao i na tehničkim i tehničko-tehnološkim fakultetima u Podgorici. Kroz obuke, koje će biti prilagođene ciljnim grupama, mladi ljudi će biti upoznati sa izazovima i problemima u oblasti zaštite i zdravlja na radu, s kojima će se suočiti dolaskom na tržište rada, nakon završenog procesa obrazovanja.
Ova aktivnost će biti sprovedena u okviru projekta „Dostojanstven rad počinje dok si mlad“ koji je finansiran u od strane Evropske komisije i Ministrastva javne uprave, a koji se realizuje u saradnji i uz podršku NVO Prima i YouthHUB mreže Zapadnog Balkana i Turske.
Poziv je otvoren do 16. jula 2022.
title_en: Call for lecturers under the project “Decent work starts while you are young”
excerpt_en: On 8 July 2022 UZNR CG invited members of the Association, specialists in occupational safety and health, to apply as lecturers for the workshops planned for secondary schools and faculties during October and November 2022.
content_en:
UZNR CG invites experts in occupational safety and health (members of the Association) to lecture at educational workshops and training sessions to be held during October and November 2022 in secondary vocational schools in Podgorica, Bijelo Polje and Nikšić, as well as at the technical and technological faculties in Podgorica. Through the training, which will be tailored to its target groups, young people will learn about the challenges and problems in occupational safety and health that they will face when they enter the labour market after finishing their education.
This activity will be carried out under the project “Decent work starts while you are young”, financed by the European Commission and the Ministry of Public Administration, and implemented in cooperation with and with the support of the NGO Prima and the YouthHUB network of the Western Balkans and Türkiye.
The call is open until 16 July 2022.

title: Sastanak sa predstavnicima MOSHA-e
excerpt: U okviru BALcanOSH mreže, 1. juna 2022. održan je sastanak predsjednika UZNR CG Zdenka Jankovića i koordinatorke Đine Janković sa predsjednikom makedonskog udruženja MOSHA Milanom Petkovskim i koordinatorkom Slavicom Petkovskom.
content:
U okviru aktivnosti BALcanOSH mreže, 01.06.2022. godine je održan radni sastanak predstavnika UZNRCG i MOSHA-e. Sastanku su prisustvovali predsjednik UZNRCG Zdenko Janković, nacionalna koordinatorka za Crnu Goru Đina Janković, predsjednik MOSHA-e Milan Petkovski i nacionalna koordinatorka za Makedoniju Slavica Petkovska.
Tema sastanka su bile buduće aktivnosti u okviru projekta „Unaprjeđenje uslova rada i zaštite i zdravlja na radu kao podrška zemljama Zapadnog Balkana u procesu pristupanja Evropskoj uniji“ i način i dinamika njihove realizacije.
Zaključeno je da je neophodno posvećeno, sinergijskim djelovanjem, raditi na pronalaženju najefikasnijih načina za prevazilaženje izazova koji se tiču modela saradnje između stručnjaka za oblast ZZNR i donosioca odluka u zemlji i regionu, bolje koordinacije svih aktera koji su uključeni u proces implementacije zakona, te unaprjeđenje istih, uz stvaranje prostora za povećanje ulaganja u istraživanja, posebno kada su u pitanju razlozi povređivanja na radnim mjestima, evidencije o povredama i profesionalnim bolestima i uvođenje ZZNR u obrazovni sistem.
Ponovo je akcenat stavljen na jednu od važnih prepreka u realizaciji planiranih aktivnosti i napretku stanja u ovoj oblasti, a to je nepostojanje Nacionalnog Savjeta za zaštitu i zdravlje na radu u Crnoj Gori. Aktivnosti UZNRCG i u narednom periodu moraju biti usmjerene na stvaranje uslova za formiranje takvog tijela.
Sljedeći sastanak, na kojem će biti prisutni partneri iz svih IPA zemalja učesnica projekta, je najavljen za kraj juna i biće organizovan u Ohridu.
title_en: Meeting with representatives of MOSHA
excerpt_en: Within the BALcanOSH network, on 1 June 2022 UZNR CG's president Zdenko Janković and coordinator Đina Janković met the president of the Macedonian association MOSHA, Milan Petkovski, and coordinator Slavica Petkovska.
content_en:
As part of the BALcanOSH network's activities, a working meeting between representatives of UZNR CG and MOSHA was held on 1 June 2022. It was attended by UZNR CG's president Zdenko Janković, national coordinator for Montenegro Đina Janković, MOSHA's president Milan Petkovski and national coordinator for North Macedonia Slavica Petkovska.
The meeting concerned the coming activities under the project “Improving working conditions and occupational safety and health in support of the Western Balkan countries in the EU accession process” and how and when they will be carried out.
It was concluded that dedicated, synergistic work is needed to find the most effective ways of overcoming the challenges regarding models of cooperation between OSH specialists and decision-makers in the country and the region, better coordination of all the actors involved in implementing the legislation and improving it, and creating scope for greater investment in research — particularly into the causes of injuries at work, records of injuries and occupational diseases, and the introduction of OSH into the education system.
Emphasis was again placed on one of the important obstacles to carrying out the planned activities and to progress in this field: the absence of a National Council for Occupational Safety and Health in Montenegro. In the period ahead UZNR CG's work must continue to be directed at creating the conditions for such a body to be formed.
The next meeting, to be attended by partners from all the IPA countries taking part in the project, is announced for the end of June and will be held in Ohrid.

title: Potpisivanje ugovora sa „Alfa Centrom Nikšić“
excerpt: UZNR CG je 31. maja 2022. potpisalo ugovor sa „Alfa Centrom Nikšić“ za realizaciju projekta „For healthier workplaces 2022–2024 in Montenegro“.
content:
Podgorica, 31. maj 2022.
Potpisan je ugovor sa „Alfa Centrom Nikšić“ za realizaciju projekta „For healthier workplaces 2022-2024 in Montenegro“.
Ovaj projekat biće realizovan u okviru regionalnog projekta „Poboljšanje uslova rada i zaštite i zdravlja na radu, kao podrška zemljama Zapadnog Balkana u procesu pristupanja Evropskoj uniji“, čije se aktivnosti realizuju i IPA zemljama - Makedoniji, Kosovu, Crnoj Gori, Srbiji i Albaniji.
