title: Završna konferencija u okviru projekta "Gradi znanje – zaštiti sebe" i promocija Vodiča za inspektore rada za oblast zaštite i zdravlja na radu
excerpt: Na završnoj konferenciji projekta "Gradi znanje – zaštiti sebe", 8. oktobra 2021, predstavljeni su rezultati projekta i Vodič za inspektore rada koji je izradio inspektor Zlatko Popović.
content:
08. oktobar 2021.
Završna konferencija u okviru projekta „Gradi znanje - zaštiti sebe“ je održana 08.oktobra 2021. godine u hotelu CUE.
Na konferenciji, na kojoj je bilo prisutno 30 učesnika, predstavljeni su rezultati jednogodišnjeg projekta „Gradi znanje - zaštiti sebe“, finansiranog od strane Ministarstva ekonomskog razvoja. Osim toga, prezentovan je Vodič za inspektore koji je izrađen u cilju da upozna inspektore rada za oblast zaštite i zdravlja na radu sa neophodnim vještinama za sprovođenje djelotvorne inspekcijske kontrole uslova rada i zaštite i zdravlja na radu u građevinarstvu.
Cilj konferencije je bilo unapređenje zaštite na radu na gradilištima, ali i unapređenje rada inspektora za oblast zaštite i zdravlja na radu, koji predstavljaju glavni regulatorni instrument za sprovođenje Zakona o zaštiti i zdravlju na radu. Inspekcija rada se, pored nedostatka opreme, suočava i sa problemom ograničenog broja inspektora sa tehničko–ekspertskim znanjima potrebnim za inspekcijski nadzor na gradilištima. Iz tog razloga je potrebno ojačati tehničke kapacitete inspektora rada za oblast zaštite i zdravlja na radu, kako bi se obezbjedile integrisane usluge i veći broj nadzora sa postojećim raspoloživim resursima.
Imajući u vidu visok broj povreda na radu u građevinarstvu, kroz Vodič koji je izrađen u okviru aktivnosti projekta i koji je ovom prilikom prezentovan, inspektori rada za oblast zaštite i zdravlja upoznali su se se sa neophodnim vještinama za sprovođenje djelotvorne inspekcijske kontrole uslova rada i zaštite i zdravlja na radu u građevinskom sektoru. Publikovani Vodič će inspektorima poslužiti kao smjernice koje će omogućiti sprovođenje proaktivnih posjeta na gradilištima, budući da inspekcijske posjete igraju odlučujuću ulogu u sprečavanju nesreća na gradilištima i problem zdravlja, što je i navedeno u Konvenciji MOR-a o bezbjednosti i zdravlju u građevinarstvu iz 1988. br.167 u članu35(b).
Planirano je da konferenciju otvore predstavnici Ministarstva ekonomskog razvoja, međutim kao oni nijesu bili u mogućnosti da uzmu učešće, to je učinila Đina Janković, predstavnica Udruženja zaštite na radu Crne Gore i koordinatorka projkta.
Nakon prezentovanja Vodiča za inspektore rada za oblast zaštite i zdravlja na radu u građevinskom sektoru, čiji je autor Zlatko Popović, inspektor rada i koordinator za poslove zaštite i zdravlja na radu (UIP), uslijedila je diskusija, budući da su svi prisutni bili iz oblasti zaštite i zdravlja na radu, imali brojna pitanja za inspektore.
Jedan od zaključaka ove konferencije je bilo i to da cilj svih nas bude obezbjeđivanje onoga što Zakon o ZZNR podrazumijevaeva – „obezbjeđivanje uslova na radu koji ne dovode do povreda na radu, profesionalnih bolesti i bolesti u vezi sa radom“. Interes društva, svih subjekata i svakog pojedinca je da ostvari najviši nivo zaštite i zdravlja na radu, da se neželjene posljedice kao što su povrede na radu, profesionalne bolesti i bolesti u vezi sa radom svedu na najmanju moguću mjeru (prihvatljivi rizik) odnosno da se ostvare uslovi rada u kojima bi zaposleni imao osjećaj zadovoljstva pri obavljanju svojih profesionalnih zadataka. Za ostvarivanje osnovnog cilja neophodan je sistematski pristup u preventivnom djelovanju i povezivanju svih subjekata koji su nosioci određenih obaveza i aktivnosti na nacionalnom nivou.
Zdrava, motivisana i zadovoljna radna snaga je važna za socijalnu i ekonomsku dobrobit svake države. Zaštita i zdravlje na radu doprinose većem zadovoljstvu zaposlenih, a time i njih kao građana, većoj produktivnosti i većoj zainteresovanosti za ostvarivanje organizacionih ciljeva i interesa. Nizak nivo zaštite i zdravlja na radu utiče na: sniženje motivacije, smanjenje radnog učinka, povećanje fluktuacije, povećanje broja povreda na radu, povećanje stope bolovanja i povećanje stope invaliditeta. Nesreće na radu i povrede smanjuju bruto domaći proizvod i smanjuju dobrobit države i drugih subjekata. Svaka povreda na radnom mjestu i svako profesionalno oboljenje, koje stekne zaposleni na radnom mjestu, za poslodavca je veliki trošak. Umorni, demotivisani i nezadovoljni zaposleni nijesu produktivni, efikasni i kreativni pri radu, a iz toga proizlaze najveći gubici za poslodavca.
Trenutna epidemiološka situacija kako u svijetu, tako i u Crnoj Gori, nam je pokazala koliko je oblast zaštite i zdravlja na radu važna, kao i koliko tek treba da se radi na njenom unapređenju, a svjesni činjenice da su zaposleni u Crnoj Gori najveći resurs i da zdravlje zaposlenih na radnim mjestima predstavlja prioritet, svi očekujemo da će zaštita i zdravlje na radu biti jedan od prioroteta u radu Vlade Crne Gore.
Kada su poslodavci u pitanju, najvažnije je, da oni shvate da ulaganje u zaštitu i zdravlje svojih zaposlenih nije biznis barijera, već ulaganje u najvažniji kapital svake kompanije, što ih čini prepoznatim, društveno odgovornim, ali i konkurentnim i poželjnim poslodavcem na tržištu rada.
Jedno od pokrenutih pitanja je bio i kvalitet rada ovlašćenih organizacija. U Crnoj Gori ima preko 40 ovlašćenih organizacija, preko 500 lica koji su položili stručni ispit. Od tog broja, predpostavlja se da samo 1/3 njih radi na poslovima ZZNR. Ono što je pozitivno u svemu tome, sa čime su se i učesnici konferencije složili, jeste da se iz kvantiteta može selekcijom dobiti kvalitet
Pokrenuto je i pitanje u vezi zvaničanog Pravilnika o ovlašćenim organizacijama, koji je star 16 godina, i postignuta je saglasnost da Udruženje pokrene inicijativu za izmjenu istog.
U narednom periodu će takođe biti aktuelizovano pitanje na temu zašto i kako je moguće da resorna ministarstva nemaju izrađen Akte o procjeni rizika, niti imaju stručna lica za zaštitu i zdravlje na radu.
Kao veliki problem je izdvojen i rad koordinatora K1 i K2, s kojim se na terenu suočavaju kako ovlašćena stručna lica, ovlašćene organizacije, tako i inspektori rada za oblast zaštite i zdravlja na radu.
Podgorica, 10.10.2021. godine
Izvještaj pripremila i sačinila
Đina Janković
title_en: Closing conference of the project “Build knowledge – protect yourself” and launch of the Guide for labour inspectors in occupational safety and health
excerpt_en: At the closing conference of the project “Build knowledge – protect yourself” on 8 October 2021, the project's results were presented along with the Guide for labour inspectors produced by inspector Zlatko Popović.
content_en:
8 October 2021
The closing conference of the project “Build knowledge – protect yourself” was held on 8 October 2021 at the Hotel CUE.
The conference, attended by 30 participants, presented the results of the one-year project “Build knowledge – protect yourself”, financed by the Ministry of Economic Development. It also presented a Guide for inspectors, produced in order to acquaint labour inspectors for occupational safety and health with the skills needed to carry out effective inspections of working conditions and of occupational safety and health in construction.
The conference set out to improve safety at work on construction sites and to improve the work of occupational safety and health inspectors, who are the main regulatory instrument for enforcing the Law on Occupational Safety and Health. Besides a lack of equipment, the labour inspectorate also faces the problem of having only a limited number of inspectors with the technical and expert knowledge needed for inspections on construction sites. The technical capacity of occupational safety and health inspectors must therefore be strengthened so that integrated services and a greater number of inspections can be provided with the resources available.
Given the high number of injuries at work in construction, the Guide produced under the project and presented on this occasion acquainted occupational safety and health inspectors with the skills needed to carry out effective inspections of working conditions and of occupational safety and health in the construction sector. The published Guide will serve inspectors as guidance enabling proactive visits to construction sites, since inspection visits play a decisive role in preventing accidents and health problems on sites, as stated in Article 35(b) of ILO Convention No. 167 of 1988 on safety and health in construction.
The conference was to have been opened by representatives of the Ministry of Economic Development, but as they were unable to attend it was opened by Đina Janković, representing the Occupational Safety Association of Montenegro and project coordinator.
After the presentation of the Guide for labour inspectors for occupational safety and health in the construction sector, written by Zlatko Popović, labour inspector and coordinator for occupational safety and health work (Administration of Inspection Affairs), there was a discussion, since everyone present worked in occupational safety and health and had a great many questions for the inspectors.
One of the conference's conclusions was that our shared goal should be to secure what the Law on OSH means by “providing working conditions that do not lead to injuries at work, occupational diseases or work-related illnesses”. It is in the interest of society, of every organisation and of every individual to achieve the highest level of occupational safety and health, to reduce unwanted consequences such as injuries at work, occupational diseases and work-related illnesses to the lowest possible level (acceptable risk), and to create working conditions in which employees feel satisfied as they carry out their professional tasks. Achieving that basic goal requires a systematic approach to preventive action and to bringing together all those who bear particular obligations and duties at national level.
A healthy, motivated and satisfied workforce is important to the social and economic wellbeing of any country. Occupational safety and health contributes to greater satisfaction among employees, and thereby among citizens, to higher productivity and to greater interest in achieving organisational goals and interests. A low level of occupational safety and health leads to lower motivation, reduced performance, higher turnover, more injuries at work, higher rates of sick leave and higher rates of disability. Accidents and injuries at work reduce gross domestic product and diminish the wellbeing of the state and of others. Every injury at the workplace and every occupational disease an employee contracts at work is a major cost to the employer. Tired, demotivated and dissatisfied employees are not productive, efficient or creative at work, and from that follow an employer's greatest losses.
The current epidemiological situation, both worldwide and in Montenegro, has shown us how important occupational safety and health is and how much work still needs to be done to improve it. Aware that employees are Montenegro's greatest resource and that their health at work is a priority, we all expect occupational safety and health to be one of the priorities of the Government of Montenegro's work.
As for employers, the most important thing is for them to understand that investing in the safety and health of their employees is not a barrier to business but an investment in every company's most important capital, which makes them recognised, socially responsible, and also competitive and attractive employers on the labour market.
One question raised was the quality of the work of licensed organisations. Montenegro has more than 40 licensed organisations and more than 500 people who have passed the professional examination. Of that number, it is thought that only a third work in OSH. What is positive about this, as the conference's participants agreed, is that quantity can be turned into quality through selection.
The question of the official Rulebook on licensed organisations, now 16 years old, was also raised, and it was agreed that the Association should launch an initiative to amend it.
In the period ahead the question of why and how it is possible that the responsible ministries have no risk assessment acts and no occupational safety and health professionals will also be raised.
The work of K1 and K2 coordinators was singled out as a major problem, encountered in the field by licensed professionals, licensed organisations and occupational safety and health inspectors alike.
Podgorica, 10 October 2021
Report prepared and compiled by
Đina Janković

title: Promocija Vodič za inspektore rada za oblast zaštite i zdravlja na radu u građevinskom sektoru
excerpt: UZNRCG je pozvao na Završnu konferenciju 8. oktobra u Hotelu CUE, na kojoj je predstavljen Vodič za inspektore rada za oblast zaštite i zdravlja na radu u građevinarstvu.
content:
Poštovani,
Udruženje zaštite na radu Crne Gore organizuje Završnu konferenciju na kojoj će biti predstavljeni rezultati jednogodišnjeg projekta „Gradi znanje - zaštiti sebe“, finansiranog od strane Ministarstva ekonomskog razvoja, na kojoj će biti predstavljen Vodič za inspektore koji je izrađen u cilju da upozna inspektore rada za oblast zaštite i zdravlja na radu sa neophodnim vještinama za sprovođenje djelotvorne inspekcijske kontrole uslova rada i zaštite i zdravlja na radu u građevinarstvu.
Obuke će se održati, u petak, 08. oktobra, u 12.00h u Hotelu CUE.
Cilj
Cilj ove konferencije je unapređenje rada inspektora rada za oblast zaštite i zdravlja na radu, koji predstavljaju glavni regulatorni instrument za sprovođenje Zakona o zaštiti i zdravlju na radu. Inspekcija rada se, pored nedostatka opreme, još suočava i sa problemom ograničenog broja inspektora sa tehničko – ekspertskim znanjima potrebnim za inspekciju na gradilištima. Iz tog razloga je potrebno ojačati tehničke kapacitete inspektora rada za oblast zaštite i zdravlja na radu, kako bi se obezbjedile integrisane usluge i veći broj nadzora sa postojećim raspoloživim resursima. Imaući u vidu visok broj povreda na radu u građevinarstvu, cilj ove konferencije je da se inspektori rada za oblast zaštite i zdravlja na radu upoznaju sa neophodnim vještinama za sprovođenje djelotvorne inspekcijske kontrole usloova rada i zaštite i zdravlja na radu u građevinskom sektoru.
Na konferenciji će, takođe, biti predstavljen i Vodič, izrađen namjenski za ovu priliku.
Publikovani Vodič će inspektorima poslužiti kao smjernice koje će omogućiti sprovođenje proaktivnih posjeta na gradilištima, budući da inspekcijske posjete igraju odlučujuću ulogu u sprečavanju nesreća na gradilištima i problem zdravlja, što je i navedeno u Konvenciji MOR-a o bezbjednosti i zdravlju u građevinarstvu iz 1988. br.167 u članu35(b).

title: Obuka na gradilištu Izgradnje turističkog naselja Portonovi, Kumbor – Herceg Novi
excerpt: UZNRCG je 24. avgusta 2021. obučio radnike firmi Pizzarotti Montenegro i Star Landscape na gradilištu turističkog naselja Portonovi, uz podjelu zaštitne opreme i informativnih materijala.
content:
Izvođači radova:
Pizzarotti Montenegro d.o.o. Herceg Novi, i Star Landscape Architecture & Construction d.o.o. Podgorica
- 24.08.2021.
U skladu sa aktivnostima projekta „Gradi znanje – zaštiti sebe“, finansiranog od strane Ministarstva ekonomskog razvoja, Udruženje zaštite na radu Crne Gore organizovalo je obuke za zaposlene na gradilištu izgradnje turističkog naselja Portonovi iz firmi: Pizzarotti Montenegro d.o.o. Herceg Novi i Star Landscape Architecture & Construction d.o.o. Podgorica.
Budući da je, statistički gledano, oko 90% zaposlenih u građevinskom sektoru muškaraca, a u odnosu na starosne grupe, najveći broj spada u grupu od 35 do 44 godine, a nešto manje u grupu od 25 do 34 godine. Procenat onih zaposlenih koji imaju završenu samo osnovnu školu je i dalje jako veliki. Osim toga, postoji značajan udio rada na crno, što je prepoznato kao još jedan problem - činjenica da se Crna Gora godinama u nazad borila sa nedostatkom adekvatne radne snage i isti nadomještala zapošljavanjem radne snage iz regiona, a najveći broj radno angažovanih na gradilištima dolazi iz Albanije.
Cilj ove obuke bio je jačanje kapaciteta zaposlenih, budući da postoji velika neispunjena potreba za unapređenjem kapaciteta iz oblasti zaštite i zdravlja na radu, kako kod poslodavca, tako i kod zaposlenih, kako bi djelotvornije primjenjivali mjere ZZNR. Ovo je postignuto kroz obuke, angažovanje kompetetnih stručnjaka iz ove oblasti. Akcenat je naročito bio stavljen na edukaciji zaposlenih sa niskim nivoom obrazovanja, kod kojih načešće dolazi do povreda, kroz praktičnu obuku na licu mjesta, na samom greadilištu, pri čemu ih je, tim sastavljen od stručnjaka iz oblasti ZZNR upoznao sa njihovim pravima, obavezama i odgovornostima.
Obuku su održali stručnjaci u oblasti zaštite i zdravlja na radu, koji ujedno rade kao stručna lica i koordinatori - Tanja Šćepanović i Marjan Brčić.
Kroz održane praktične obuke na licu mjesta (na samom gradilištu) oko 15 zaposlenih je upoznato sa najčešćim opasnostima na gradilištu prilikom obavljanja uobičajnih radova, kao što su, između ostalih, rad na visini, budući da na padove otpada visoki procenat nesreća na gradilištima i, zbog same prirode njihovog posla, veliki broj tih nesreća rezultira ozbiljnim pa čak i smrtonosnim povredama. Shodno tome, svim zaposlenima i njihovim organizatorima rada pružene su informacije kroz obuku i percepciju rizika i bezbjednim radnim praksama sa aspekta rada na visini, kao i o važnosti upotrebe sredstava lične zaštite, kao zaštitne mjere kako bi se spriječilo izlagaje opasnosti, a sve u skladu s Pravilnikom o mjerama zaštite i zdravlja na radu na privremenim i pokretnim gradilištima.
Tom prilikom učesnicima obuke su podjeljeni flajeri koji sadrže osnovne, na slikovit način prikazane informacije o najvećim rizicima od povređivanja na gradilištima. Osim toga, učesnici obuke su dobili promotivne majice, jakne i kabanice BALcan OSH mreže.
U Podgorici, 25.08.2021.godine
Izvještaj sačinila
Đina Janković
title_en: Training on the construction site of the Portonovi tourist resort, Kumbor – Herceg Novi
excerpt_en: On 24 August 2021 UZNR CG trained workers from Pizzarotti Montenegro and Star Landscape on the Portonovi tourist resort construction site, distributing protective equipment and information materials.
content_en:
Contractors:
Pizzarotti Montenegro d.o.o. Herceg Novi, and Star Landscape Architecture & Construction d.o.o. Podgorica
- 24 August 2021
In line with the activities of the project “Build knowledge – protect yourself”, financed by the Ministry of Economic Development, the Occupational Safety Association of Montenegro organised training for workers on the Portonovi tourist resort construction site from the companies Pizzarotti Montenegro d.o.o. Herceg Novi and Star Landscape Architecture & Construction d.o.o. Podgorica.
Statistically, some 90% of those employed in the construction sector are men, and by age group the largest number fall between 35 and 44, with somewhat fewer between 25 and 34. The proportion of employees with only a primary education remains very high. There is also a significant amount of undeclared work, which is recognised as a further problem — the fact that for years Montenegro has struggled with a shortage of suitable labour and has made up for it by employing workers from the region, with most of those working on construction sites coming from Albania.
The aim of this training was to build employees' capacity, since there is a great unmet need to strengthen occupational safety and health capacity, among employers and employees alike, so that OSH measures can be applied more effectively. This was achieved through training and by engaging competent specialists in the field. Emphasis was placed in particular on educating employees with a low level of education, among whom injuries most often occur, through practical training on site, where a team of OSH specialists acquainted them with their rights, obligations and responsibilities.
The training was delivered by specialists in occupational safety and health who also work as safety professionals and coordinators — Tanja Šćepanović and Marjan Brčić.
Through practical training on site, some 15 employees learned about the most common dangers on a construction site during ordinary work, including work at height — since falls account for a high proportion of accidents on sites and, by the very nature of the work, a great many of those accidents result in serious and even fatal injuries. Accordingly, all the employees and their work organisers were given information through the training on risk perception and safe working practice as regards work at height, and on the importance of using personal protective equipment as a protective measure to prevent exposure to danger, all in line with the Rulebook on occupational safety and health measures on temporary and mobile construction sites.
Participants were given leaflets setting out, in pictures, basic information about the greatest risks of injury on construction sites. They also received promotional T-shirts, jackets and rain capes from the BALcanOSH network.
Podgorica, 25 August 2021
Report compiled by
Đina Janković

title: Obuka na gradilištu izgradnje puta Vrulja – Mijakovići, u Pljevljima
excerpt: UZNRCG je 21. avgusta 2021. obučio 43 radnika firme "Tehnoput" na gradilištu puta Vrulja–Mijakovići kod Pljevalja, o opasnostima zemljanih radova i rukovanja mašinama.
content:
Izvođač radova „Tehnoput“ d.o.o. Podgorica - 21.08.2021.
U skladu sa aktivnostima projekta „Gradi znanje – zaštiti sebe“, finansiranog od strane Ministarstva ekonomskog razvoja, Udruženje zaštite na radu Crne Gore organizovalo je obuke za zaposlene iz firme „Tehnoput“ doo Podgorica, koja izvodi radove na gradilištu izgradnje puta Vrulja-Mijakovići u Pljevljima.
Obuku su održali stručnjaci u oblasti zaštite i zdravlja na radu, koji ujedno rade kao stručna lica i koordinatori - Tanja Šćepanović i Marjan Brčić.
Kroz održane praktične obuke na licu mjesta (na samom gradilištu) oko 43 zaposleih, različitih zanimanja, je upoznato sa najčešćim opasnostima na gradilištu prilikom obavljanja uobičajnih radova.
Na navedenom gradilištu se obavljaju radovi na nasipanju, ravnjanju i valjanju terena i izgradnji potpornih zidova. Pored ovih poslova obavljaju se i poslovi opsluživanja mobilne drobilice. Edukacija zaposlenih je usmjerena na opasnosti i štetnosti na gradilištu sa posebnim osvrtom na opasnosti i štetnosti zaposlenih koji upravljaju teretnim vozilima i rukuju građevinskim mašinama.
U Pljevljima, 21.08.2021.godine
Izvještaj sačinila

title_en: Training on the Vrulja – Mijakovići road construction site in Pljevlja
excerpt_en: On 21 August 2021 UZNR CG trained 43 workers from the company “Tehnoput” on the Vrulja–Mijakovići road site near Pljevlja, covering the dangers of earthworks and machinery operation.
content_en:
Contractor: “Tehnoput” d.o.o. Podgorica - 21 August 2021
In line with the activities of the project “Build knowledge – protect yourself”, financed by the Ministry of Economic Development, the Occupational Safety Association of Montenegro organised training for employees of the company “Tehnoput” d.o.o. Podgorica, which is carrying out work on the Vrulja–Mijakovići road construction site in Pljevlja.
The training was delivered by specialists in occupational safety and health who also work as safety professionals and coordinators — Tanja Šćepanović and Marjan Brčić.
Through practical training on site, some 43 employees in a range of occupations learned about the most common dangers on a construction site during ordinary work.
The work on this site involves filling, levelling and rolling ground and building retaining walls. Alongside that, work is done operating a mobile crusher. The training focused on the dangers and harmful factors on the site, with particular reference to those affecting employees who drive goods vehicles and operate construction machinery.
Pljevlja, 21 August 2021
Report compiled by
Đina Janković

title: Obuka na gradilištu izgradnje objekata 3B3, 4.6, 3B4 u turističkom naselju Luštica Bay

content:
Izvođač radova „M.D.I. DSD“ d.o.o. Tivat
Investitor Luštica Development Tivat – 06.08.2021.

DSD“ d.o.o. Tivat koja izvodi radove na gradilištu izgradnje objekata 3B3, 4.6, 3B4 u turističkom naselju Luštica Bay u Tivtu.

Contractor: “M.D.I. DSD” d.o.o. Tivat
Investor: Luštica Development Tivat – 6 August 2021

DSD” d.o.o. Tivat, which is carrying out work on the construction site of buildings 3B3, 4.6 and 3B4 in the Luštica Bay resort in Tivat.
The training was delivered by specialists in occupational safety and health who also work as safety professionals and coordinators — Tanja Šćepanović and Marjan Brčić.

Through practical training on site, some 10 employees in a range of occupations learned about the most common dangers on a construction site during ordinary work, including work at height, work at depth, handling loads, work with hand and power tools, work with reinforcement and formwork, moving around the site and more.

title: Obuka zaposlenih na gradilištima - Jul 2021
excerpt: U okviru projekta "Gradi znanje – zaštiti sebe", UZNRCG je tokom jula 2021. obučio oko 200 radnika na više gradilišta u Tivtu i Podgorici, uz prevod na albanski i turski jezik.
content:
- Jul 2021
U skladu sa aktivnostima projekta „Gradi znanje – zaštiti sebe“, finansiranog od strane Ministarstva ekonomskog razvoja, Udruženje zaštite na radu Crne Gore organizovalo je obuke za zaposlene na nekoliko gradilišta u Tivtu i Podgorici.
Budući da je, statistički gledano, oko 90% zaposlenih u građevinskom sektoru muškaraca, a u odnosu na starosne grupe, najveći broj spada u grupu od 35 do 44 godine, a nešto manje u grupu od 25 do 34 godine. Procenat onih zaposlenih koji imaju završenu samo osnovnu školu je i dalje jako veliki. Osim toga, postoji značajan udio rada na crno, što je prepoznato kao još jedan problem - činjenica da se Crna Gora godinama u nazad borila sa nedostatkom adekvatne radne snage i isti nadomještala zapošljavanjem radne snage iz regiona, a najveći broj radno angažovanih na gradilištima dolazi iz Turske i Albanije.
Cilj ove obuke bio je jačanje kapaciteta zaposlenih, budući da postoji velika neispunjena potreba za unapređenjem kapaciteta iz oblasti zaštite i zdravlja na radu, kako kod poslodavca, tako i kod zaposlenih, kako bi djelotvornije primjenjivali mjere ZZNR. Ovo je postignuto kroz obuke, angažovanje kompetetnih stručnjaka iz ove oblasti. Akcenat je naročito bio stavljen na edukaciji zaposlenih sa niskim nivoom obrazovanja, kod kojih načešće dolazi do povreda, kroz praktičnu obuku na licu mjesta, na samom greadilištu, pri čemu ih je, tim sastavljen od stručnjaka iz oblasti ZZNR upoznao sa njihovim pravima, obavezama i odgovornostima.
Obuku su održali stručnjaci u oblasti zaštite i zdravlja na radu, koji ujedno rade kao stručna lica i koordinatori - Tanja Šćepanović i Marjan Brčić.
Kroz održane praktične obuke na licu mjesta (na samom gradilištu) oko 200 zaposleih je upoznato sa najčešćim opasnostima na gradilištu prilikom obavljanja uobičajnih radova, kao što su, između ostalih, rad na visini, budući da na padove otpada visoki procenat nesreća na gradilištima i, zbog same prirode njihovog posla, veliki broj tih nesreća rezultira ozbiljnim pa čak i smrtonosnim povredama. Shodno tome, svim zaposlenima i njihovim organizatorima rada pružene su informacije kroz obuku i percepciju rizika i bezbjednim radnim praksama sa aspekta rada na visini, kao i o važnosti upotrebe sredstava lične zaštite, kao zaštitne mjere kako bi se spriječilo izlagaje opasnosti, a sve u skladu s Pravilnikom o mjerama zaštite i zdravlja na radu na privremenim i pokretnim gradilištima.
Budući da su na svim gradilištima zaposleni, osim ljjudi sa našeg govornog područja, ljudi iz Turske i Albanije, obuka je organizovana u posebnim grupama – na crnogorskom jeziku i uz prevodioce na Albanskom i Turskom jeziku.
Tom prilikom učesnicima obuke su podijeljeni flajeri koji sadrže osnovne, na slikovit način prikazane informacije o najvećim rizicima od povređivanja na gradilištima. Osim toga, učesnici obuke su dobili promotivne majice, jakne i kabanice BALcan OSH mreže.
Ovom prilikom su ustanovljene velike razlike u organizaciji rada na samim gradilištima, njihovoj uređenosti, higijeni, nivou informisanosti i osvješćenosti zaposlenih o zaštiti na radu, neophodnosti korišćenja lične zaštitne opreme i načinu kako se odnose prema poštovanju pravila i upustava, ali i poznavanju svojih prava, obaveza i odgovornosti.
Zaposleni su iskazali strah da bi ukoliko bi tražili svoja prava od poslodavca, u tom slučaju, po njihovom doživljaju to značilo gubitak posla i povratak u zemlje iz kojih su došli (Turska, Albanija).
title_en: Training for workers on construction sites – July 2021
excerpt_en: Under the project “Build knowledge – protect yourself”, during July 2021 UZNR CG trained some 200 workers on several sites in Tivat and Podgorica, with interpreting into Albanian and Turkish.
content_en:
- July 2021
In line with the activities of the project “Build knowledge – protect yourself”, financed by the Ministry of Economic Development, the Occupational Safety Association of Montenegro organised training for workers on several construction sites in Tivat and Podgorica.
Statistically, some 90% of those employed in the construction sector are men, and by age group the largest number fall between 35 and 44, with somewhat fewer between 25 and 34. The proportion of employees with only a primary education remains very high. There is also a significant amount of undeclared work, which is recognised as a further problem — the fact that for years Montenegro has struggled with a shortage of suitable labour and has made up for it by employing workers from the region, with most of those working on construction sites coming from Türkiye and Albania.
The aim of this training was to build employees' capacity, since there is a great unmet need to strengthen occupational safety and health capacity, among employers and employees alike, so that OSH measures can be applied more effectively. This was achieved through training and by engaging competent specialists in the field. Emphasis was placed in particular on educating employees with a low level of education, among whom injuries most often occur, through practical training on site, where a team of OSH specialists acquainted them with their rights, obligations and responsibilities.
The training was delivered by specialists in occupational safety and health who also work as safety professionals and coordinators — Tanja Šćepanović and Marjan Brčić.
Through practical training on site, some 200 employees learned about the most common dangers on a construction site during ordinary work, including work at height — since falls account for a high proportion of accidents on sites and, by the very nature of the work, a great many of those accidents result in serious and even fatal injuries. Accordingly, all the employees and their work organisers were given information through the training on risk perception and safe working practice as regards work at height, and on the importance of using personal protective equipment as a protective measure to prevent exposure to danger, all in line with the Rulebook on occupational safety and health measures on temporary and mobile construction sites.
Since the workers on all these sites include, besides people from our own language area, people from Türkiye and Albania, the training was organised in separate groups — in Montenegrin and with interpreters into Albanian and Turkish.
Participants were given leaflets setting out, in pictures, basic information about the greatest risks of injury on construction sites. They also received promotional T-shirts, jackets and rain capes from the BALcanOSH network.
On this occasion great differences were found in how work is organised on the sites themselves, in their orderliness and hygiene, in employees' level of information and awareness about safety at work, in the need to use personal protective equipment, in how they regard compliance with rules and instructions, and in their knowledge of their own rights, obligations and responsibilities.
Employees expressed a fear that if they were to ask their employer for their rights, that would — as they saw it — mean losing their job and returning to the countries they came from (Türkiye, Albania).

title: Godišnje druženje članova UZNR CG - Trebinje
excerpt: Članovi UZNRCG posjetili su 26. juna 2021. Trebinje, u okviru tradicionalnog godišnjeg druženja, obišavši Hercegovačku Gračanicu, manastir Tvrdoš i stari grad.
content:
26.06.2021. – Trebinje
Članovi Udruženja zaštite na radu Crne Gore su 26.06.2021. godine, u okviru tradicionalnog godišnjeg druženja, organizovali zajednički izlet tokom kojeg su posjetili Trebinje.
Ovom prilikom učesnici su obišli:
• Hercegovačku Gračanicu
• Manastir i Vinariju Tvrdoš
• Arslanagića most
• Stari grad Trebinje i centar grada
Grad Trebinje je grad platana i grad Sunca, jer ga ono obasjava čak 260 dana u godini. Jedna od asocijacija na ovo mjesto, je čuveno hercegovačko vino, koje su članovi imali priliku da degustiraju u podrumima manastira Tvrdoš, koji se nalazi na samo 5 km od Trebinja i sagrađen je na temeljima crkve iz IV vijeka. Danas bez dileme spada u red najstarijih kulturno istorijskih spomenika u Republici Srpskoj.
Nakon obilaska Manastira i Vinarije Tvrdoš, naši članovi su imali priliku da obiđu i turistički kompleks Hercegovačke Gračanice – koji je najposjećeniji vjerski objekat u Istočnoj Hercegovini. Izgrađen je da ispuni želju poznatog pjesnika Jovana Dučića, navedenu u testamentu. Sa vidikovca ovog kompleksa pruža se divan pogled na grad Trebinje i njegovu okolinu, rijeku Trebišnjicu, divni Arslanagića ili Perovića most, vrh Leotar, itd., gdje je ovo druženje ovekovječeno grupnim fotografijama.
Takođe, članovi su imali priliku da sa turističkim vodičem obiđu Stari grad Trebinje i da uživaju u njegovim čarima, kao i u hladovini džinovskih platana, nakon čega je za kraj druženja upriličen zajednički ručak u restoranu Brana Gorica.
title_en: Annual gathering of UZNR CG members – Trebinje
excerpt_en: On 26 June 2021 members of UZNR CG visited Trebinje as part of their traditional annual gathering, taking in Hercegovačka Gračanica, the Tvrdoš monastery and the old town.
content_en:
26 June 2021 – Trebinje
On 26 June 2021, as part of their traditional annual gathering, members of the Occupational Safety Association of Montenegro organised a joint outing to Trebinje.
Participants visited:
• Hercegovačka Gračanica
• the Tvrdoš monastery and winery
• the Arslanagić bridge
• the old town of Trebinje and the town centre
Trebinje is the town of plane trees and of the sun, which shines on it for as many as 260 days a year. One association with the place is the famous Herzegovinian wine, which members had the opportunity to taste in the cellars of the Tvrdoš monastery, just 5 km from Trebinje and built on the foundations of a 4th-century church. Today it is without doubt among the oldest cultural and historical monuments in the Republika Srpska.
After visiting the Tvrdoš monastery and winery, our members had the opportunity to see the Hercegovačka Gračanica complex — the most visited religious site in eastern Herzegovina. It was built to fulfil the wish of the well-known poet Jovan Dučić, set out in his will. From the complex's viewpoint there is a wonderful view over Trebinje and its surroundings, the river Trebišnjica, the beautiful Arslanagić (or Perović) bridge, the peak of Leotar and more, where the gathering was immortalised in group photographs.
Members also had the opportunity to tour the old town of Trebinje with a guide and to enjoy its charms and the shade of its giant plane trees, after which the gathering closed with a shared lunch at the Brana Gorica restaurant.

1. Efikasan pravni okvir (politike zaštite i zdravlja na radu),
2. Edukacija/sistem obrazovanja zaštite i zdravlja na radu,
3. Jačanje ZZNR kapaciteta,
4. Promocija i podizanje svijesti iz zaštite i zdravlja na radu,
5. Evidencija zaštite i zdravlja na radu (povrede i profesionalna oboljenja),
6. Formiranje nacionalnog Savjeta za ZZNR,
7. Sektorska i međusektorska saradnja (na nacionalnom, regionalnom i međunarodnom nivou)
Podgorica, 28.06.2021.

title_en: CIN's conference “How to achieve safety and protection”
excerpt_en: On 25 June 2021 the Centre for Investigative Journalism of Montenegro held a conference on the safety of construction workers, with UZNR CG, the Administration of Inspection Affairs and the Ministry of Economic Development taking part.
content_en:
Hotel Cue, 25 June 2021
Organised by CIN, the conference “How to achieve safety and protection” was held under the project “How safe are the workers on our construction sites”, financed by the Ministry of Economic Development. Speakers at the conference included Đina Janković of the Occupational Safety Association of Montenegro (UZNR CG), Zlatko Popović, labour inspector and coordinator for occupational safety and health work in Montenegro (Administration of Inspection Affairs), Jevrosima Pejović, director of the Directorate for Labour and Employment (Government of Montenegro), Milka Tadić Mijović, president of the Centre for Investigative Journalism of Montenegro (CIN-CG), Jovana Bošković, independent adviser for occupational safety at the Ministry of Economic Development, Slavoljub Šćekić, editor-in-chief of CIN-CG, and Goran Kapor, journalist at ND Vijesti.
Đina Janković of UZNR CG presented the strategic objectives for the regional development of occupational safety and health for 2019–2023, namely:
1. An effective legal framework (occupational safety and health policy),
2. Education and the OSH education system,
3. Strengthening OSH capacity,
4. Promotion and awareness-raising in occupational safety and health,
5. OSH records (injuries and occupational diseases),
6. Establishing a national Council for OSH,
7. Sectoral and cross-sectoral cooperation (at national, regional and international level)
Podgorica, 28 June 2021

title: Obuka za koordinatore K1 i K2 u fazi projektovanja i fazi izvođenja radova i inspektore rada za oblast zaštite i zdravlja na radu
excerpt: UZNRCG je, u saradnji sa Međunarodnom organizacijom rada, održao trodnevnu obuku (22–24. juna 2021) za koordinatore K1 i K2 i inspektore rada, uz učešće međunarodnih stručnjaka iz Ženeve i Srbije.
content:
22 – 24 jun 2021
U skladu sa aktivnostima projekta „Gradi znanje – zaštiti sebe“, finansiranog od strane Ministarstva ekonomskog razvoja, Udruženje zaštite na radu Crne Gore, u saradnji sa MOR-om, organizovalo je obuku za koordinatore za zaštitu i zdravlje na radu na gradilištima u fazi projektovanja i fazi izvođenja radova (K1 i K2), kao i za inspektore rada za oblast zaštite i zdravlja na radu, budući da je od ključnog značaja da koordinatori i inspektori budu što bolje obučeni kako bi pronalazili najbolja moguća rješenja i proaktivno djelovali, kada je u pitanju zaštita i zdravlje na radu zaposlenih u građevinskom sektoru.
Trodnevna obuka je održana 22. 23. i 24. juna, u Grand sali hotela CUE, i to iz dva dijela, tako što je prva dva dana obuka bila namjenjena koordinatorima K1 i K2, a trećeg dana obuka je bila za inspektore rada za oblast zaštite i zdravlja na radu, pri čemu je akcenat obuke bio na inspekcijskom nadzoru na gradilištima.
Predavači na obuci su bili međunarodni esperti:
• Andrew Christian, Specijalista za Inspekciju rada i zaštitu i zdravlje na radu, MOR, iz Ženeve
• Jovan Protić, Nacionalni koordinator MOR-a za Republiku Srbiju.
Prvog dana obuke, sem međunarodnih eksperata iz ove oblasti, priliku da se predstave učesnicia imali su i:
• Đina Janković, predstavnica UZNR CG i koordinatorka projekta „Gradi znanje-zaštiti sebe“
• Nina Krgović, predstavnica MOR-a za Crnu Goru
• Jevrosima Pejović, direktorica Direktorata za rad i zapošljavanje u Ministarstvu ekonomskog razvoja
Budući da je obuka imala interaktivni karakter, koordinatori K1 i K2 imali su priliku da iznesu svoja iskustva, probleme i zaključke. Koordinatori su bili jednoglasni kada su navodili primjere iz dosadašnjeg iskustva uočavanja opasnosti i primjene odgovarajućih mjera zaštite na gradilištima. Komentari, sugestije i primjedbe su se odnosile na sledeće:
• Komfuznost i nerazumjevanje uloge koordinatora, budući da obaveze i dužnosti koordinatora nisu definisane posebnim podzakonskim aktom koji bi, po njihovm mišljenju bio neophodan.
• Nedefinisana komunikacija između koordinatora i stručnih lica na gradilištima pri čemu su navedeni brojni primjeri nepostojanja komunikacije na zadovoljavajuććem nivou, pa čak i odbijanje koordinatora da komuniciraju i sarađuju sa stručnim licima.
• Nedostatak konkretnih uputstava i smjernica pri izradi dokumentacije prilikom projektovanja, kao i svim ostalim procedurama rada koordinatora od trenutka ulaska na gradilište.
• Postojanje pojave da jedno lice istovremeno obavlja i poslove stručnog lica i koordinatora, pri čemu se dovodi u pitanje postojanje komfilikta interesa.
• Skela kao osnovno sredstvo zaštite od pada sa visine postavlja se samo u fazi fasaderskih radova, dok se sve ostale faze (AB radovi, zidarski, montaža spoljne stolarije i krovopokrivački radovi) izvode bez skele kao osnovnog sredstva zaštite od pada sa visine.
• Zaštitne ograde kao osnovno sredstvo od pada u dubinu i pada preko otvorenih ivica pretežno se ne postavljaju, a i to što bude postavljeno uklanja se sa završetkom radova firme koja izvodi grube građevinske radove.
• Podgrade kao osnovno sredstvo zaštite temeljne jame, rovova i ostalih zemljanih radova, izuzev rijetkih projekata na primorju sa više podzemnih etaža, nisu predviđeni glavnim projektom. Dalje ti troškovi nisu jasno definisani, nisu jasno naznačeni i kao takvi nisu ukalkulisani u cijenu radova. Naknadno nametanje primjene navedenih mjera zaštite nailazi na otpor, s jedne strane Investitora koji neće da čuje za ove troškove jer ima ugovorenu cijenu radova, s druge strane Izvođača koji nema računicu da u sklopu ugovorene cijene vrši primjenu podgrade iskopa.
• Nedefinisano prisustvo lica na gradilištu (vrijeme koje provode na gradilištu) koje je zaduženo za sprovođenje mjera zaštite (u sadašnjem zakonskom okviru riječ je o stručnom licu izvođača koji izvodi radove u cjelini ili koordinatoru K2). Uzimajući u obzir broj gradilišta u CG sa jedne strane i broj stručnih lica i koordinatora K2 sa druge strane lako je shvatiti da fizički nije moguće postići da navedena lica, stalnim prisustvom, pokriju sva gradilišta u CG u cilju primjene mjera zaštite.
Zaključeno je da se poboljšanje zaštite na radu na gradilištima može sprovesti kroz:
1. Planiranje troškova mjera zaštite u fazi izrade projektne dokumentacije
Planiranje troškova sprovesti kroz predmjer i predračun dat u sklopu Plana mjera zaštite urađenog od strane Koordinatora K1. Planom mjera zaštite definisati konstrukciono i troškovno sledeće mjere zaštite:
- zaštita temeljne jame, rovova i drugih zemljanih radova
- zaštita od pada u dubinu i pada sa otvorenih ivica
- zaštita od pada sa visine, generalno govoreći radi se o cijeni zakupa skele i radnih platformi koje će pratiti izgradnju objekta od početka do kraja izvođenja radova
stalno prisustvo lica na gradilištu koje je zaduženo za sprovođenje mjera zaštite (stručno lice izvođača koji izvodi radove u cjelini ili koordinatora K2).
2. Afirmaciju osobe koja je stalno prisutna na gradilištu, odgovornog inženjera izvođača radova u cjelini ili njegovog imenovanog zamjenika, u cilju primjene mjera zaštite.
Afirmacija osobe koja je stalno prisutna na gradilištu, odnosno odgovornog inženjera izvođača radova u cjelini ili njegovog imenovanog zamjenika
kroz zakonski okvir nametnuti obuku građevinskih inženjera na gradilištu sa aspekta prepoznavanja opasnosti i primjene mjera zaštite na gradilištu, kao i zakonske kaznene odredbe za navedena lica u slučaju nesprovođenja mjera zaštite na gradilištu. Time bi se stekli preduslovi za simultani i koordinisani rad odgovornih inženjera, stručnih lica i K2 u primjeni mjera zaštite na gradilištu. Takođe ostaviti mogućnost prebacivanja svih odgovornosti sa odgovornog inženjera Izvođača u cjelini na stručno lice ili koordinatora K2 ukoliko se sklopi takav ugovor koji predviđa stalno prisustvo stručnog lica ili K2 na gradilištu.
3. Organizovanje okruglog stola sa predstavnicima resornog ministarstva i Inspekcije rada za poslove zaštite i zdravlja na radu i stručnim licima/koordinatorima, koji bi ih tom prilikom upoznali sa konkretnim izazovima i problemima.
4. Uspostavljanje saradnje građevinske inspekcije i inspekcije rada za oblast zaštite i zdravlja na radu.
5. Jačanje saradnje između ovlašćenih organizacija za poslove ZZNR i Inspekcije rada iz oblasti ZZNR.
Inspektori rada za oblast ZZNR su naveli kao problem nepostojanje evidencije o licima koja posjeduju licencu za obavljanje poslova koordinatora K1 i K2, kao i evidencije o licima koja su imenovana za obavljanje ovih poslova za investitore.
Sveobuhvatan zaključak na ovoj obuci bio je da je neophodno sprovesti usklađivanje Zakona o planiranju prostora i izgradnji objekata sa Zakonom o ZZNR, organizovati radne sastanke nadležnog ministarstva za građevinarstvo i nadležnog ministarstva za ZZNR.
Kao mogućnost navedena je ideja da se preko Inženjerske komore obavijeste sve projektantske firme/investitori o zakonskoj obavezi imenovanja koordinatora K1 i K2.
U Podgorici, 25.06.2021. godine
Izvještaj sačinila: Đina Janković
title_en: Training for K1 and K2 coordinators at the design and construction stages and for labour inspectors for occupational safety and health
excerpt_en: Together with the International Labour Organization, UZNR CG held three days of training (22–24 June 2021) for K1 and K2 coordinators and labour inspectors, with international experts from Geneva and Serbia taking part.
content_en:
22–24 June 2021
In line with the activities of the project “Build knowledge – protect yourself”, financed by the Ministry of Economic Development, the Occupational Safety Association of Montenegro, together with the ILO, organised training for occupational safety and health coordinators on construction sites at the design and construction stages (K1 and K2) and for labour inspectors for occupational safety and health, since it is of key importance that coordinators and inspectors be as well trained as possible so that they can find the best available solutions and act proactively in matters of occupational safety and health in the construction sector.
The three-day training was held on 22, 23 and 24 June in the Grand Hall of the Hotel CUE, in two parts: the first two days were for K1 and K2 coordinators, and the third day was for labour inspectors for occupational safety and health, focusing on inspections of construction sites.
The trainers were international experts:
• Andrew Christian, specialist in labour inspection and occupational safety and health, ILO, Geneva
• Jovan Protić, ILO national coordinator for the Republic of Serbia.
On the first day, besides the international experts, participants also heard from:
• Đina Janković, representing UZNR CG and coordinator of the project “Build knowledge – protect yourself”
• Nina Krgović, the ILO's representative for Montenegro
• Jevrosima Pejović, director of the Directorate for Labour and Employment at the Ministry of Economic Development
Since the training was interactive, K1 and K2 coordinators had the opportunity to share their experience, problems and conclusions. The coordinators were unanimous in the examples they gave from their experience of identifying dangers and applying appropriate protective measures on construction sites. Their comments, suggestions and objections concerned the following:
• Confusion and misunderstanding about the coordinator's role, since coordinators' obligations and duties are not defined in a dedicated piece of secondary legislation, which in their view is essential.
• Undefined communication between coordinators and safety professionals on sites, with numerous examples given of communication not being at a satisfactory level and even of coordinators refusing to communicate and work with safety professionals.
• A lack of concrete instructions and guidance for producing documentation during design, and for all the other procedures a coordinator follows from the moment they enter a site.
• The practice of one person carrying out the work of both safety professional and coordinator, which raises the question of a conflict of interest.
• Scaffolding, as the basic means of protection against falls from height, is put up only during the rendering phase, while all the other phases (reinforced concrete work, bricklaying, fitting external joinery and roofing) are carried out without scaffolding as the basic means of protection against falls from height.
• Guard rails, as the basic means of protection against falls into depth and over open edges, are mostly not installed, and what is installed is removed once the company carrying out the structural work has finished.
• Shoring, as the basic means of protecting foundation pits, trenches and other excavation work, is — apart from rare projects on the coast with several basement levels — not provided for in the main design. Those costs are then not clearly defined or indicated and are therefore not built into the price of the works. Imposing these protective measures afterwards meets resistance from the investor, who will not hear of the cost because the price of the works is contractually fixed, and from the contractor, for whom shoring the excavation within the agreed price does not add up.
• The undefined presence on site (the time spent there) of the person responsible for implementing protective measures (under the current legal framework, the safety professional of the main contractor or the K2 coordinator). Given the number of construction sites in Montenegro on the one hand and the number of safety professionals and K2 coordinators on the other, it is easy to see that it is physically impossible for those people to cover every site in Montenegro through constant presence in order to apply protective measures.
It was concluded that safety at work on construction sites can be improved through:
1. Planning the cost of protective measures at the design documentation stage
Cost planning should be carried out through the bill of quantities and cost estimate provided within the Plan of Protective Measures produced by the K1 coordinator. The Plan of Protective Measures should define, in terms of both construction and cost, the following measures:
- protection of foundation pits, trenches and other excavation work
- protection against falls into depth and over open edges
- protection against falls from height — generally speaking, the cost of hiring scaffolding and working platforms that will accompany the construction of the building from start to finish
- the constant presence on site of the person responsible for implementing protective measures (the safety professional of the main contractor or the K2 coordinator).
2. Strengthening the position of the person constantly present on site — the main contractor's responsible engineer or their appointed deputy — with a view to applying protective measures.
Strengthening the position of the person constantly present on site, that is, the main contractor's responsible engineer or their appointed deputy, by requiring through the legal framework that site engineers be trained in recognising dangers and applying protective measures on site, and by introducing legal penalties for those persons where protective measures are not implemented. That would create the conditions for responsible engineers, safety professionals and K2 coordinators to work simultaneously and in a coordinated way in applying protective measures on site. The option should also remain of transferring all responsibility from the main contractor's responsible engineer to the safety professional or K2 coordinator where a contract is concluded providing for the constant presence of the safety professional or K2 coordinator on site.
3. Organising a round table with representatives of the responsible ministry and the labour inspectorate for occupational safety and health and with safety professionals and coordinators, who would acquaint them with the concrete challenges and problems.
4. Establishing cooperation between the construction inspectorate and the labour inspectorate for occupational safety and health.
5. Strengthening cooperation between organisations licensed for OSH work and the labour inspectorate for OSH.
The labour inspectors for OSH cited as a problem the absence of any register of people licensed to work as K1 and K2 coordinators, and of any register of people appointed to carry out that work for investors.
The overall conclusion of the training was that the Law on Spatial Planning and Construction must be aligned with the Law on OSH, and that working meetings should be organised between the ministry responsible for construction and the ministry responsible for OSH.
One possibility raised was to inform all design firms and investors, through the Chamber of Engineers, of the legal obligation to appoint K1 and K2 coordinators.
Podgorica, 25 June 2021
Report compiled by: Đina Janković

title: Seminar "Zdravlje i zaštita na radu u vremenu pandemije COVID 19"
excerpt: Savez sindikata Crne Gore realizovao je 18. i 19. juna 2021. u Kotoru drugi modul seminara za sindikalne predstavnike o zaštiti na radu tokom pandemije, uz učešće UZNRCG i Ministarstva ekonomskog razvoja.
content:
U okviru projekta „Sindikat sindikatu“ koji implementiraju sindikati iz Švedske LO, TCO I SACO, Savez sindikata Crne Gore je realizovao drugu aktivnost na polju edukacije iz oblasti zaštite i zdravlja na radu. Seminar pod nazivom „Zdravlje i zaštita na radu u vremenu pandemije COVID 19“, koji je namijenjen članovima sindikata – predstavnicima zaposlenih za zaštitu i zdravlje na radu i ostalim licima koja se bave ovom tematikom u svojim preduzećima, a koji su učestvovali na prvom modulu, je održan 18. i 19. juna 2021. godine u Sind centru Muo, u Kotoru.
Cilj seminara je bilo jačanje kapaciteta sindikata kroz stručnu obuku sindikalnih predstavnika zaposlenih na polju zaštite i zdravlja na radu. Za potrebe projekta angažovani su predavači-eksperti iz Ministarstva ekonomskog razvoja i Udruženja zaštite na radu Crne Gore/BALcanOSH mreže.
Đina Janković, kao predstavnica BALcanOSH mreže/UZNRCG je osim uvodnog obraćanja u kojem je upoznala prisutne sa aktivnostima organizacije iz koje dolazi, imala i tri prezentacije na temu:
1. Strateški ciljevi razvoja zaštite i zdravlja na radu u regionu,
2. Stres zaposlenih, Covid i burnout,
3. Ergonomija u službi zdravlja zaposlenih.
Predstavnice Ministarstva ekonomskog razvoja, samostalne savjetnice - Maja Mijović i Jovana Bošković su prisutnima predstavile Analizu trenutnog stanja i zacrtanih ciljeva u oblasti zaštite i zdravlja na radu, kao i Strateško planiranje u oblasti zaštite i zdravlja na radu, pri čemu su prisutni, kroz rad u grupama, analizirali probleme u oblasti zaštite i zdravlja na radu, na osnovu čega je kreirano drvo ciljeva koje sadrži strateške i operativne ciljeve, definisanje pratećih indikatora uspjeha sa odgovarajućim pasošima indikatora, a sve u cilju prepoznavanja izazova i dobijanja što većeg podataka, koji će biti korišćeni pri izradi Strategije za unapređenje zaštite i zdravlja na radu u Crnoj Gori 2022. – 2027. godine, sa Akcionim planom implementacije za 2022. godinu.
Stručni saradnik za međunarodnu saradnju SSCG i član Regionalne ITUC/PERC SEE OHS mreže – Vladimir Krsmanović je prisutnima prezentovao istraživanje na temu Pravedna tranzicija i „ozelenjivanje“ ekonomije.
Izvještaj pripremila i sačinila
Đina Janković
Podgorica, 21.06.2021.
title_en: Seminar “Health and safety at work in the time of the COVID-19 pandemic”
excerpt_en: On 18 and 19 June 2021 in Kotor the Confederation of Trade Unions of Montenegro delivered the second module of a seminar for union representatives on safety at work during the pandemic, with UZNR CG and the Ministry of Economic Development taking part.
content_en:
Under the project “Union to union”, implemented by the Swedish trade unions LO, TCO and SACO, the Confederation of Trade Unions of Montenegro carried out its second activity in occupational safety and health education. The seminar “Health and safety at work in the time of the COVID-19 pandemic”, aimed at union members — employees' representatives for occupational safety and health and others working on the subject in their companies who took part in the first module — was held on 18 and 19 June 2021 at the Sind Centre in Muo, Kotor.
The aim of the seminar was to strengthen the unions' capacity through professional training for union representatives of employees in occupational safety and health. Trainers and experts from the Ministry of Economic Development and the Occupational Safety Association of Montenegro / BALcanOSH network were engaged for the project.
Đina Janković, representing the BALcanOSH network / UZNR CG, gave an opening address acquainting participants with her organisation's activities and also gave three presentations:
1. Strategic objectives for the development of occupational safety and health in the region,
2. Employee stress, Covid and burnout,
3. Ergonomics in the service of employees' health.
Representatives of the Ministry of Economic Development, independent advisers Maja Mijović and Jovana Bošković, presented an analysis of the current situation and the objectives set in occupational safety and health, and strategic planning in the field. Working in groups, participants analysed the problems facing occupational safety and health, on the basis of which an objective tree was produced setting out strategic and operational objectives and defining accompanying success indicators with their corresponding indicator passports — all with a view to identifying challenges and gathering as much data as possible for use in drafting the Strategy for Improving Occupational Safety and Health in Montenegro 2022–2027, with an implementation action plan for 2022.
Vladimir Krsmanović, expert associate for international cooperation at the Confederation of Trade Unions of Montenegro and a member of the regional ITUC/PERC SEE OHS network, presented research on just transition and the greening of the economy.
Report prepared and compiled by
Đina Janković
Podgorica, 21 June 2021

title: Radni sastanak BALcanOSH mreža – Ministarstvo ekonomskog razvoja, UZNRCG, Unija slobodnih sindikata CG
excerpt: Predstavnici UZNRCG i makedonskog udruženja za zaštitu na radu održali su niz sastanaka sa Ministarstvom ekonomskog razvoja i Unijom slobodnih sindikata Crne Gore o daljem razvoju zaštite i zdravlja na radu.
content:
Predstavnici Udruženja zaštite na radu Crne Gore i makedonskog Udruženja zaštite na radu održali su danas nekoliko sastanaka sa predstavnicima koji se bave zaštitom i zdravljem na radu u Crnoj Gori.
Prvi sastanak održan je u Ministarstvu ekonomskog razvoja Crne Gore sa predstavnicima Direktorata za rad i zapošljavanje.
Na ovom sastanku predstavljene su realizovane aktivnosti i rezultati iz prethodne godine u oblasti ZZNR, kao rezultat saradnje i razmjene iskustva u BALcanOSH mreži. Definisani su izazovi i način rada za naredni period, kao i strateški ciljevi definisani u Regionalnoj strategiji 2019-2023, a sve u cilju obezbjeđivanja sigurnih i zdravih radnih mjesta u Crnoj Gori. Posebno su izdvojeni: formiranje nacionalnog Savjeta za ZZNR, doprinos efikasnosti pravnog okvira, evidencije o povredama i profesionalnim oboljenjima kao i edukacije u smislu uvođenja ZZNR u obrazovni sistem Crne Gore.
Nakon toga je održan radni sastanak u prostorijama UZNRCG sa članovima UO.
Domaćini trećeg radnog sastanka su bili predstavnici Unije slobodnih sindikata Crne Gore. Akcenat razgovora bio je na: razmjeni iskustva, realizaciji zajedničkih ideja, nacrtu plana primjene i organizaciji zajedničkih foruma i radionica.
title_en: Working meeting: BALcanOSH network – Ministry of Economic Development, UZNR CG, Union of Free Trade Unions of Montenegro
excerpt_en: Representatives of UZNR CG and the Macedonian occupational safety association held a series of meetings with the Ministry of Economic Development and the Union of Free Trade Unions of Montenegro on the further development of occupational safety and health.
content_en:
Representatives of the Occupational Safety Association of Montenegro and the Macedonian occupational safety association today held several meetings with those working on occupational safety and health in Montenegro.
The first meeting was held at Montenegro's Ministry of Economic Development with representatives of the Directorate for Labour and Employment.
The meeting presented the activities carried out and the results achieved over the past year in OSH as a result of cooperation and the exchange of experience within the BALcanOSH network. The challenges and the way of working for the period ahead were defined, along with the strategic objectives set out in the Regional Strategy 2019–2023, all with a view to securing safe and healthy workplaces in Montenegro. Particular mention was made of establishing a national Council for OSH, contributing to the effectiveness of the legal framework, records of injuries and occupational diseases, and education in the sense of introducing OSH into Montenegro's education system.
A working meeting was then held at UZNR CG's premises with members of the management board.
The third working meeting was hosted by representatives of the Union of Free Trade Unions of Montenegro. The discussion focused on the exchange of experience, carrying out joint ideas, a draft implementation plan and the organisation of joint forums and workshops.

title: I i II modul treninga "Program za razvoj mreža i koalicija"
excerpt: Predstavnice UZNRCG su prošle obuku Resursnog centra (CRNVO) o razvoju funkcionalnih mreža i koalicija organizacija civilnog društva, sa fokusom na javno zastupanje i lobiranje.
content:
Predstavnice UZNRCG su prošle obuku „Razvoj funkcionalnih mreža i koalicija organizacija civilnog društva u Crnoj Gori“ koju je organizovao Resursni centar (CRNVO).
Cilj ovog treninga je bio usmjeren na sticanju znanja o strategijama javnog zastupanja, istraživanja tema kampanja, taktikama javnog zastupanja i lobiranju, pripremi i podnošenju Inicijativa.
Učesnice programa se se upoznale sa mehanizmima građanskog učešća u kreiranju i primjeni javnih politika na lokalnom i nacionalnom nivou, kao i sa institucionalnim okvirom za saradnju NVO i organa vlasti na lokalnom i nacionalnom nivou. Kroz identifikovanje problema i strategije javnog zastupanja, ciljeve kampanje, kao i zaključke i evaluaciju, su učestvovale u radu, primjenjujući elemente javnog zastupanja i istraživanja teme kampanje, kroz praktičan rad grupe i prezentaciju iste. Korišćeni su mehanizmi za definisanje i analizu ciljane publike, izgradnju i značaj mreža i koalicija za javno zastupanje, taktike i lobiranje. Na kraju obuke je u okviru radne grupe pripremljen Akcioni plan za kampanju javnog zastupanja.
title_en: Modules I and II of the training “Programme for developing networks and coalitions”
excerpt_en: Representatives of UZNR CG completed training run by the Resource Centre (CRNVO) on developing functional networks and coalitions of civil society organisations, focusing on public advocacy and lobbying.
content_en:
Representatives of UZNR CG completed the training “Developing functional networks and coalitions of civil society organisations in Montenegro”, organised by the Resource Centre (CRNVO).
The training aimed to build knowledge of public advocacy strategies, researching campaign topics, advocacy tactics and lobbying, and preparing and submitting initiatives.
Participants learned about the mechanisms for citizen participation in creating and applying public policy at local and national level, and about the institutional framework for cooperation between NGOs and public authorities at local and national level. Through identifying problems and advocacy strategies, campaign objectives, conclusions and evaluation, they took part in the work by applying the elements of public advocacy and campaign research through practical group work and its presentation. Mechanisms were used for defining and analysing target audiences, for building networks and coalitions for public advocacy and understanding their importance, and for tactics and lobbying. At the end of the training the working group prepared an action plan for a public advocacy campaign.

title: Svjetski dan zaštite i zdravlja na radu
excerpt: UZNRCG je 28. aprila 2021. obilježio Svjetski dan zaštite i zdravlja na radu konferencijom o građevinarstvu, uz dodjelu šest nagrada i predstavljanje Nacionalnog profila zaštite na radu u Crnoj Gori.
content:
Udruženje zaštite na radu Crne Gore je u koorganizaciji i uz podršku MOR-a i Ministarstva ekonomskog razvoja, obilježilo Svjetski dan zaštite i zdravlja na radu konferencijom koja je organizovana u okviru projekta „Gradi znanje – zaštiti sebe“ koji je podržan i finansiran od strane Ministarstva ekonomskog razvoja.
Akcenat ove konferencije je bio na zaštiti i zdravlju na radu u građevinarstvu koje je jedna od najvećih, ali i najrizičnijih industrijskih grana po život i zdravlje zaposlenih, kako na globalnom nivou, tako i u Crnoj Gori. Zaposleni u građevinskom sektoru izloženi su velikom riziku od povreda na radu, naročito teškim, kao i onim sa smrtnim ishodom, posebno u slučajevima kada su za rad angažovani radnici koji nisu osposobljeni za bezbjedan rad ili nisu prošli prethodnu provjeru zdravstvenih sposobnosti. Ovakva situacija je zabrinjavajuća, budući da je jedno od mjerila zatvaranja poglavlja 19 implementacija Zakona o zaštiti i zdravlju na radu, koji je posljednjim izmjenama usklađen sa relevantnim Direktivama EU s posebnim akcentom na sektor građevinarstva. S tim u vezi, Udruženje zaštite na radu Crne Gore je, u prethodnom periodu, realizovalo brojne aktivnosti koje su fokusirane na sektor građevinarstva, u okviru projekta „Gradi znanje – zaštiti sebe“ koji je podržan i finansiran od strane Ministarstva ekonomskog razvoja.
Povodom Svjetskog dana zaštite i zdravlja na radu, udruženje je ovom prilikom uručilo 6 nagrada za tri pravna i tri fizička lica, koja su dala najveći doprinos u ovoj oblasti u građevinskom sektoru u prethodnoj godini, a cilj je bio da se time skrene pažnja na neke dobre prakse, koje će predstavljati podsticaj i primjer drugima.
Dobitnici nagrada su u kategoriji pravnih lica: „Ramel“, „Čelebić“ i „CEDIS“, a u kategoriji fizičkih lica: inženjer zaštite životne sredine Jovan Radenović, novinar „Vijesti“ Goran Kapor i diplomirani inženjer brodomašinstva Marjan Brčić.
MOR je predstavio vrlo značajan dokument - Nacionalni profil zaštite i zdravlja na radu u Crnoj Gori, koji je izradio prof.dr Petar Bulat. Profil pruža brojne informacije iz oblasti zaštite i zdravlja na radu, koje se odnose se na veliki broj povreda na radu, visoku smrtnu incidencu, nedostatak evidencija o povredama i profesionalnim oboljenjima, nedostatak Zavoda za medicinu rada, nepostojanje Nacionalnog savjeta za zaštitu i zdravlje na radu, nezastupljenost zaštite i zdravlja na radu u obrazovnom sistemu Crne Gore – probleme na koje Udruženje zaštite na radu Crne Gore ukazuje već dugi niz godina.
UZNR CG očekuje da će, nakon prezentacije ovog važnog dokumenta, nadležne javne institucije dati veći prioritet rješavanju ovih problema, što će doprinijeti boljoj implementaciji Zakona o zaštiti i zdravlju na radu, a samim tim i poboljšanju uslova rada, smanjenju broja povreda i profesionalnih oboljenja.
title_en: World Day for Safety and Health at Work
excerpt_en: On 28 April 2021 UZNR CG marked World Day for Safety and Health at Work with a conference on construction, presenting six awards and launching the National Occupational Safety and Health Profile of Montenegro.
content_en:
The Occupational Safety Association of Montenegro, jointly with and with the support of the ILO and the Ministry of Economic Development, marked World Day for Safety and Health at Work with a conference organised under the project “Build knowledge – protect yourself”, supported and financed by the Ministry of Economic Development.
The conference focused on occupational safety and health in construction, one of the largest industrial sectors but also one of the riskiest for employees' lives and health, both globally and in Montenegro. Employees in construction are exposed to a high risk of injury at work, particularly serious and fatal injuries, especially where the workers engaged have not been trained for safe work or have not undergone a prior check of their fitness for work. This situation is worrying, since one of the benchmarks for closing Chapter 19 is implementation of the Law on Occupational Safety and Health, which in its most recent amendments was aligned with the relevant EU directives with particular emphasis on the construction sector. Accordingly, the Occupational Safety Association of Montenegro has carried out numerous activities focused on the construction sector under the project “Build knowledge – protect yourself”, supported and financed by the Ministry of Economic Development.
To mark World Day for Safety and Health at Work, the Association presented 6 awards on this occasion to three organisations and three individuals who made the greatest contribution in this field in the construction sector over the past year, with the aim of drawing attention to good practice that will encourage and serve as an example to others.
The award winners in the organisations category were “Ramel”, “Čelebić” and “CEDIS”, and in the individuals category the environmental engineer Jovan Radenović, the “Vijesti” journalist Goran Kapor and the marine engineering graduate Marjan Brčić.
The ILO presented a highly significant document — the National Occupational Safety and Health Profile of Montenegro, produced by Professor Petar Bulat. The profile offers a wealth of information on occupational safety and health relating to the high number of injuries at work, the high fatality rate, the lack of records of injuries and occupational diseases, the absence of an institute of occupational medicine, the absence of a National Council for Occupational Safety and Health and the absence of occupational safety and health from Montenegro's education system — problems the Occupational Safety Association of Montenegro has been pointing to for many years.
UZNR CG expects that, following the presentation of this important document, the competent public institutions will give greater priority to solving these problems, which will lead to better implementation of the Law on Occupational Safety and Health and thereby to better working conditions and fewer injuries and occupational diseases.
